## While Humanity Moves Forward, the British Panic
**Join Dennis Speed and Prof. Cliff Kiracofe tonight!

Hop on at 9pm ET on Rumble** | [](https://laroucheorganization.nationbuilder.com/r?u=gFB7Tylx1fPa2jOHrKCBPn7diLKGIEcKYMcGpiCFllS7rBWGRBkkOaBixJd6dxmaSrMu-BVbcU4Q7jzgeA_VSJgF9X103Y22dpM00-daqD8&e=8fa7b86c85d8b09f0015ebe544605791&utm_source=laroucheorganization&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=3202025_fireside_chat&n=3 "Listen on Rumble") [Listen on Rumble](https://laroucheorganization.nationbuilder.com/r?u=gFB7Tylx1fPa2jOHrKCBPn7diLKGIEcKYMcGpiCFllS7rBWGRBkkOaBixJd6dxmaSrMu-BVbcU4Q7jzgeA_VSJgF9X103Y22dpM00-daqD8&e=8fa7b86c85d8b09f0015ebe544605791&utm_source=laroucheorganization&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=3202025_fireside_chat&n=3)

[](https://laroucheorganization.nationbuilder.com/r?u=1yI5FFrJJjILKygrTDlNJTqg44MwtKMuZB7Fq023O6eRjPB9G9iOop4Bs464F1zl&e=8fa7b86c85d8b09f0015ebe544605791&utm_source=laroucheorganization&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=3202025_fireside_chat&n=4 "Join on Zoom") [Join on Zoom](https://laroucheorganization.nationbuilder.com/r?u=1yI5FFrJJjILKygrTDlNJTqg44MwtKMuZB7Fq023O6eRjPB9G9iOop4Bs464F1zl&e=8fa7b86c85d8b09f0015ebe544605791&utm_source=laroucheorganization&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=3202025_fireside_chat&n=4)

The unfolding shift taking place from an imperial rules-based order to a new paradigm is to be seen in the recent 2 1/2 hour phone call between President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin, which was rightly characterized by Russian strategic analyst Fyodor Lukyanov as a sign that “real diplomacy has returned.” There is the real chance, Lukyanov noted, that there will be real negotiations, but there are two extremes to be avoided. He said, “One is the illusion that everything will be resolved quickly and painlessly, and the other is the cynical belief that any agreement is fundamentally unattainable.”
Of course, the British Empire and its European “allies” are determined to painlessly maintain the illusion that no peace agreements can be reached, and are acting right now to sabotage any normalization of relations between the U.S. and Russia. On Tuesday, the German parliament voted to uncap its budget and prepare for massive military spending to deter the supposed Russian “threat,” ignoring the fact that German voters have overwhelmingly voted against the current coalition. Today, British Prime Minister Keir Starmer is convening a meeting of the “Coalition of the Willing” to further the effort to put NATO “peacekeeping” troops in Ukraine.
The other tools in the British arsenal include setting off new waves of violence in Southwest Asia, where the U.S. has just begun a bombing campaign against the Houthis in Yemen, and Israel has officially broken the ceasefire agreement negotiated with Hamas and have killed over 400 Palestinians in the Gaza Strip as of yesterday. In respect to Trump’s actions in Yemen, conservative political commentator Tucker Carlson has his expressed opposition, noting that “the costs of future acts of terrorism on American soil may be even higher.”
The new dynamic emerging from the Trump-Putin phone call has the potential to bring about a coalition of nations from all parts of the world, most emphatically Russia, India, China and the United States, into a new global security architecture by which conflicts can be resolved peacefully, and with no ill-will towards the other. Our initiative to end the special relationship between the British Empire and the U.S. must be pushed, along with the work of Schiller Institute Chairwoman Helga Zepp-LaRouche in bringing about a “new security and development architecture” for all nations of the world.
Today’s speaker will be Prof. Cliff Kiracofe, President of the Washington Institute for Peace and Development and former senior professional staff member of the US Senate Committee on Foreign Relations.
****
**Have Fun,**
Dennis Speed

|
#
Earlier today, President Trump signed an executive order directing the Education Secretary to take**“all necessary steps to facilitate the closure of the Department of Education.”**
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104226851/534673826/-1606559029?refcode=em-3.20.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNTg3OWY2ZS1lNzA1LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dOn55xy_ubdn2PSn3g6J8BBaHAwQQcMoafRfl_mcrmA=)
**Trump Signs Order Aimed at Closing Education Dept.**
---

Let’s be clear: this is an all-out attack on our kids, our teachers, and the future of public education in America.

That means fewer resources, bigger class sizes, and worse outcomes – at a time when our schools are underfunded, teachers are stretched thin, and families are struggling.

**Not on my watch.**

I’ve spent my career fighting for kids – running Michigan Head Start, helping to lead the Michigan Department of Education, and driving millions of dollars to improve Detroit schools. And as a mom of six, I know firsthand what’s at stake. I won’t sit back while the administration tries to tear down our children's future.

Right now, we’re pushing back in the House and in the courts to block this reckless (and illegal) move, but the truth is the fight would be much stronger if we had the majority.

That’s why I’m reaching out:

**[If we want to put a real, lasting check on the administration, we need to win back the House in 2026. And that means defending Trump-won districts like mine in MI-08. Team: On April 1, Wisconsin voters will decide between progressive Dane County Circuit Court Judge Susan Crawford and conservative former Attorney General Brad Schimel in a race that will determine the ideological balance of the court.
Why is this election important? Wisconsin's Supreme Court elections are nonpartisan, but the ideological balance of the court has widespread ramifications for voting rights, civil rights, and a slew of other state policy implications. State Supreme Courts like this one are also often the final arbiters of election disputes, as we saw in both the 2020 and 2022 elections.
In 2023 progressive judge Janet Protasiewicz won a similar race and flipped the balance of the Wisconsin Supreme Court, giving the state a 4-3 pro-voting rights majority. The outcome of this year's election will determine whether Wisconsin holds that liberal majority moving forward or if the court slides back to the suppressive policies of Wisconsin's past.
Now, news has broken that a political action committee backed by billionaire Elon Musk has scheduled hundreds of thousands of dollars worth of TV ads in Wisconsin. Given everything going on, we can all guess which candidate these ads from the Musk-backed "Building America’s Future" group are going to support.
Team: Turnout is key and we have to get the word out in Wisconsin to make sure every defender of voting rights gets to the polls. Just like we've seen with North Carolina, one court seat can mean a few House seats and be enough to keep a suppressive majority in place in Congress. Fuel our voter outreach efforts with $25 or whatever you can right today to help defend voting rights in Wisconsin and beyond >> [] Voter Action Project WPR: Group tied to Elon Musk investing in Wisconsin ahead of Supreme Court race [=] Team: On April 1, Wisconsin voters will decide between progressive Dane County Circuit Court Judge Susan Crawford and conservative former Attorney General Brad Schimel in a race that will determine the ideological balance of the court. Why is this election important? Wisconsin's Supreme Court elections are nonpartisan, but the ideological balance of the court has widespread ramifications for voting rights, civil rights, and a slew of other state policy implications. State Supreme Courts like this one are also often the final arbiters of election disputes, as we saw in both the 2020 and 2022 elections. In 2023 progressive judge Janet Protasiewicz won a similar race and flipped the balance of the Wisconsin Supreme Court, giving the state a 4-3 pro-voting rights majority. The outcome of this year's election will determine whether Wisconsin holds that liberal majority moving forward or if the court slides back to the suppressive policies of Wisconsin's past. Now, news has broken that a political action committee backed by billionaire Elon Musk has scheduled hundreds of thousands of dollars worth of TV ads in Wisconsin. Given everything going on, we can all guess which candidate these ads from the Musk-backed "Building America’s Future" group are going to support. | | Peter,

The government funding bill passed by GOP majorities in Congress last week is disastrous for a multitude of reasons. One that cannot be overlooked is that it cedes Congress’s power to review tariffs proposed by President Trump. **I voted No.**

House Republican leaders quietly snuck this rule change into the bill to avoid public backlash, because even they know Trump’s tariffs are wildly unpopular.

Katie Porter here with exciting news, **I’m running to be California’s next governor.**
**More below, but first, can you split a donation of $10 between State Democrats Committee and our campaign to become a founding donor today?**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/86957?refcode=em20250320-8831&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8831%2E614464%2EgvyFjb)**
Peter, I didn’t make this decision lightly. But with an emboldened Trump in the White House and MAGA loyalists doing his bidding day in and day out, California—and our country—need a leader who is ready to go toe to toe with extremists.
I first ran for office in 2018. I was a single mom of three little kids, running in a district that Republicans had held for decades. **But I ran because I couldn’t sit on the sidelines as I watched Trump try and destroy our country.** As a consumer protection attorney, I wanted to use my experience to hold him and his administration accountable.
With the support of folks like you, I made it to Congress, where I was able to claw back billions from drug companies who ripped us off and pass laws cracking down on health care companies that wrongfully denied care.
**I feel the same call to serve today as I did during Trump’s first administration.**
California is experiencing real challenges. We must become resilient to natural disasters and tackle climate change. We must address the high cost of housing, health care, and groceries. And we must continue to protect our LGBTQ+ community members and safeguard abortion access.
**We don’t have to choose between defending our values and tackling our challenges.** We can work with businesses to create good paying jobs in California and hold corporations accountable. We can keep communities safe and uphold civil rights.
**I’m never one for BS or sugar coating, so I’ll be honest— this race won’t be a walk in the park!** There are already multiple candidates in the race to succeed Governor Newsom, who is term-limited, and the primary election is just over a year away.
Today is critical for our campaign. Pundits will be looking at how much we raise in the first week of our campaign, and **that number sends a strong signal to super PACs who might consider spending against us if we look weak.**
I’m asking you to join our movement to stand up to Trump and his cronies. I’m proud to have State Democrats Committee's support in this campaign, are you with us? Please make a split donation of $10 today. It will go a long way in our people-powered campaign.

Fellow Idahoans, mark this moment: we've just passed [House Bill 135](https://substack.com/redirect/7e091bf1-1062-4d3f-bf15-3b25a830f88e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) out of committee with resounding conviction--a decisive step to safeguard our state's resources.
_**This bill rightfully terminates welfare benefits for illegal immigrants, ensuring that the hard-earned dollars of our citizens no longer fund those who byp**_ ass our laws.
Why should Idaho play host to those who flout our borders, draining public coffers while honest taxpayers bear the burden?
The answer is clear: we shouldn't, and now we won't. This is a triumph of principle over pandering, and I'm proud to see our state lead with such resolve.
I'll leave you with the wise words of Pat Buchanan from his masterpiece, "[The Death of the West](https://substack.com/redirect/4e5726cb-7096-4408-8be8-086778b7683e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)":
> _**" Uncontrolled immigration threatens to deconstruct the nation we grew up in and convert it into a conglomeration of peoples with almost nothing in common--not history, heroes, language, culture, faith, or ancestors. **_
> _**The flood of illegal aliens pouring across our borders is not a wave of refugees fleeing persecution but an army of economic opportunists, some of whom carry with them the seeds of social chaos. "**_

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Derek —
Some of my proudest accomplishments in my career in public service have
been those which served to make schools better, safer, and more affordable
for everyone.

Growing up, I had some incredible teachers who motivated me to read and
learn more about the world. From my speech teacher, who showed me the
power of the spoken word, to my English teacher, who introduced me to the
works of Shakespeare and inspired a lifelong passion for reading. I
wouldn’t be who I am today without these incredible teachers.

And I believe every Californian deserves access to high-quality education
that sets them up for a bright future. I’ve made improving schools a major
part of my life’s work — and I want to tell you a bit more about what I’ve
done for schools, and what I want to do to improve schools from the U.S.
Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=q12025_abs_em.OeZ3Kx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20250320_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1012&akid=8378%2E5257348%2E5xPpH8 ]DONATE

While I was running for California State Senate and knocking on doors in
my neighborhood, I met a mother with five children. She told me that the
textbooks her children had in school were out-of-date — in fact, her
youngest child was using the same textbook her eldest child had used ten
years earlier. A textbook so old I was told it talked optimistically about
the day we might land on the moon — and it was being used in the ‘90s.

So I got to work as a bright-eyed new legislator. I introduced a bill to
guarantee funding for up-to-date textbooks for all K-12 schools in
California.

The LA Times wrote that my bill didn’t have “a snowball’s chance in hell”
of passing — but it did, and we secured $1 billion for new textbooks.

I also played a key role in passing legislation that reduced class sizes
and helped secure critical cost-of-living increases for teacher pensions.

Every kid deserves the opportunity to go to school and learn in a safe,
welcoming environment. And their teachers deserve fair wages and benefits
for the vital work they do to help our kids succeed.

So as Trump threatens to eliminate the Department of Education and
nominates a Secretary of Education who is quite possibly *more*
unqualified than Betsy DeVos (remember her?), I’m fighting for our kids in
the U.S. Senate.

I believe that we need to significantly increase funding for Head Start
programs. This will help thousands of kids from low-income households get
access to high-quality education.

I believe we should give teachers refundable tax credits to boost teacher
compensation and address the wage gap between teachers and other
professions.

I believe that we must expand meal programs for kids. Every student should
be able to start their day with a nutritious, free breakfast and refuel
with a healthy lunch — no matter their zip code.

I believe that we should expand the Pell Grant. These grants help put
college in reach for millions of students — by passing the College for All
Act, we can make that a reality.

I believe that we must invest in teachers and schools. To allow future
generations of students to learn in safe, welcoming environments, we need
to make sure their teachers and school staff receive fair wages and the
respect they deserve.

I believe that childcare and pre-k should be universal, to ensure that all
children have access to early learning opportunities. And childcare
copayments for families should be capped at no more than 5-10% of their
income, or be waived for families at or below 150% of the federal poverty
level.

Derek, every
child deserves the opportunity to learn and thrive, just like I did as a
student growing up.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q12025_abs_em.9NB2Ka&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20250320_PM1_V1_S1&t=1013&akid=8378%2E5257348%2E5xPpH8 ]Adam Schiff as a young boy

Thank you for reading more about my work to improve our schools — as well
as my plans to keep building on that progress for all students.

— Adam

# **President Trump's Department of Education Executive Order is a slap in the face to students, teachers, and parents**
**** Today, President Trump signed an Executive Order to dismantle the Department of Education. He said he hopes Education Secretary Linda McMahon is the last Education Secretary our country ever has. Senator Hughes shared the [following statement](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100169730.172726.339&gen=1&mailing_linkid=14031) in response to the signing of the Executive Order: "Any move to abolish the Department of Education is a slap in the face to students, teachers, and parents. Yet again, President Trump, Musk, and Congressional Republicans are trying to convince the public that cutting funding, services, and jobs will bring us to an alleged golden age of America. The reality of their reckless and sloppy approach is that making cuts to education will do nothing but cause learning loss, overextended and burnt-out teachers, bigger class sizes, less resources for special education students, more toxic and broken school buildings, less technology in our classrooms, and nowhere for students and parents to turn when they are being discriminated against. Pennsylvania has a court order to adequately and constitutionally fund 70% of PA schools. Any federal cut to education funding and support will undermine our attempts to fix that problem. We need Pennsylvania's Congressional lawmakers to stand up and fight for the education of our students." #

**Please Support WAGOP's Election Integrity Efforts**
**Bellevue** —The Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP) is serious about fighting for election integrity on multiple fronts, including in Clark County and across our beautiful state.

On March 13th, Clark County Auditor Greg Kimsey was taken to court for failing to maintain the district’s voter database and allowing illegal votes to be cast in the LD 18 Senate Race.

We know these ballots were illegal because voters themselves had self-reported to the US Postal Service prior to the election that they were changing their address. To prove this, volunteers visited the addresses in question, spoke to current residents, and collected affidavits confirming that at least 312 of these voters had indeed moved out of LD 18. Keep in mind, 173 votes separated the winner from the loser in that Senate race.

Defense attorneys were successful in getting many of these affidvaits dismissed as current residents were often hesitant to sign affidavits for strangers. With these affidavits discarded, the defense argued that there was no proof that voters had done anything more than change their mailing address, and thus no definitive number of votes should be thrown out. They also argued that Kimsey did use postal service data to clean the voter rolls but admitted that some records were excluded.

Judge Banfield has extended the case, giving the plaintiffs another chance to prove negligence on the part of Greg Kimsey. The case was not a win, but it was not a loss, either. And the case remains pending.

Meanwhile, the WAGOP continues to fight vigilantly for election integrity. But it takes time, and it is costly. Please [Support The Election Integrity Legal Fund - Washington State Republican Party.](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=c2e589e90f&e=6a281f566d)

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Matthew Frolich, WAGOP Executive Director

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

| | Friend,As a strong conservative senior, I’m hoping that you will side with AMAC Action rather than with _the left-leaning AARP..._ By now you’ve probably heard of **billionaire globalist George Soros** and his support for the most radical leftist ideas on the planet.He’s injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, and our justice system. And our 82 chapters and 348 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill. With the support of conservative seniors like you, AMAC Action has confronted the radical left at every turn. And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him. And I know that together, we can counter the poisonous ideas he’s spreading through groups like the Tides Foundation and the AARP. **Just look at what we accomplished together in 2024 alone:**
---
* **We bombarded** members of Congress, state legislators, corporate executives, and the White House with a tidal wave of emails, comments, and phone calls showing that America’s conservative seniors would not back down in the face of an overreaching Biden Admin.
* **We mobilized** seniors to get out and vote early in the battleground states, resulting in a win for President Trump in all seven swing states.

Friend,
---
I know I’ve written a lot here, but it’s my hope that you’ll spare just a moment to read all that I have to say, because it’s entirely from the heart.
---
For the better part of my life, there was a time when I read the paper in the morning and saw headlines about me taking down the mob in New York...

**_“Giuliani losing his home amidst 2 indictments...”_ **
[Source: _MSNBC_]
**“In Delicious Twist, Rudy Giuliani Is at Risk of Losing All His Assets” **
[Source: _The New Republic_]
**“...federal judge in Washington, D.C., threatened [Giuliani] with severe sanctions and possible ‘imprisonment’” **
[Source: _Law & Crime News_]

---
And with my case already scheduled to go to trial, the Democrats’ goal is simple but nevertheless sinister. They want me to feel completely **ABANDONED** , completely hopeless, as I prepare to defend myself in what is no doubt the trial of my life.
---
But here’s what the Left will never understand... _America First fighters _NEVER_ _SURRENDER_ , and we _NEVER_ _ABANDON_ our fellow patriots._

When I was first wrongfully arrested and booked by the Democrats in one of the most violent jails in America, they filed my mugshot under **booking # 2313757.**

__
---
They had hoped that on that day I would also feel abandoned and isolated. **_But today, just like on the day I was arrested, I KNOW I’m not alone!_**
---
Which is why I fully intend to give my booking number a whole new meaning – **2,313,757 PATRIOTS** who joined the fight for my freedom and justice!

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znosdu8akq30m5f3tgfikuhpc3r96136bvq9pdbo_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clim4p34cdh2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.

| | Friend,As a strong conservative senior, I’m hoping that you will side with AMAC Action rather than with _the left-leaning AARP..._ By now you’ve probably heard of **billionaire globalist George Soros** and his support for the most radical leftist ideas on the planet.He’s injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, and our justice system. In the past few years, Soros has channeled millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys—including New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. What I’m about to tell you will make your blood boil—**[**but I hope it will inspire you to take action!**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zkdmahnr7fda3coc8mhv1e6aqqkgees3ftn9ntug_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clim2o74c5h2bs)** According to public tax filings, the left-leaning AARP accepted over **10 MILLION DOLLARS** —in just three years—from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.” **You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’** And the AARP is taking multi-millions from this group funded by the man whose life mission is to destroy our nation. It’s not hard to see why the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine, calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s “changing the world, $100 million at a time.”Friend, it makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.And listen to this...Of all age groups (including 18-29-year-olds!), when asked **“Do you have a favorable or unfavorable opinion of Donald Trump?”** —seniors aged 65 and older are the ONLY age group in America with a decreasing approval rating of President Trump.**Coincidence or Soros-backed AARP influence?****And so today I’m writing to sound the alarm.** To help President Trump usher in the **Golden Age of America** , AMAC Action must double and even triple our efforts against these radicals and George Soros’ network of prosecutors and Attorneys General who are obstructing President Trump’s America First Agenda.**_We can’t do it without brave patriots like you._** **[That’s why I’m asking you to follow this link to make a critical one-time donation today.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zfojuvunguul6lajqbvdnfon7usrnffror6ck69o_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clim2o74c5h2bs)****My friend, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action.** With its 2 million members, AMAC is the conservative antidote to the left-leaning AARP. And our 82 chapters and 348 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill. With the support of conservative seniors like you, AMAC Action has confronted the radical left at every turn. And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him. And I know that together, we can counter the poisonous ideas he’s spreading through groups like the Tides Foundation and the AARP. **Just look at what we accomplished together in 2024 alone:**
---
* **We bombarded** members of Congress, state legislators, corporate executives, and the White House with a tidal wave of emails, comments, and phone calls showing that America’s conservative seniors would not back down in the face of an overreaching Biden Admin.
* **We mobilized** seniors to get out and vote early in the battleground states, resulting in a win for President Trump in all seven swing states.
* **We organized** a massive “Hands Off My Medicare” Petition Drive to stop the Democrats’ horrible “Medicare for All” scheme from giving undocumented immigrants the same healthcare you get.
* **Together with Donald Trump, Jr.,** we united thousands of Americans around our **“Make America Strong Again”**
* **In Missouri and Kentucky,** we helped pass commonsense measures to stop non-citizens from voting in our elections.
* **We defeated** a radical pro-abortion amendment in Florida.
* **In Ohio,** we protected young girls from boys in their sports and in their bathrooms.
* **We stopped** left-wing financial institutions from “de-banking” conservatives in Tennessee simply because they don’t like their politics.

---
And our efforts are so effective that President Trump himself has put out the call for seniors to join conservative AMAC to stop the radical leftists who are ruining our country! AMAC Action isn’t going to back down and let the Left obstruct President Trump’s America First agenda. If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But we’re going to shout it from the rooftops so unsuspecting seniors know the truth!** We can’t do any of this critical work without you. **[Today—right now—when so much is at stake—will you please make a generous donation of $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500 or more?](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zi8evau7ne611k5t7kehkrgq0usdt8rss8dharn8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clim2o74c5h2bs)** The radical Left isn’t letting up for one minute, and neither are we.**Your AMAC Action is taking every step possible to protect the interests of you and your family—but we can’t do it without you.** We already have a full agenda for the rest of this critical year that needs financing. And now that Soros has unleashed his radical D.A.s, our fights will multiply across the nation. But please know that **ANY amount** that you can contribute, whether it’s smaller or larger, is greatly appreciated. **[**Whatever you decide, please donate within the next 72 hours so we know what resources we have to work with.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z7oq30p98qlveq7n6dm28i9bbhut8sk8ahn41288_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clim2o74c5h2bs)** If we allow radical leftists like George Soros to continue without opposition, every one of us will suffer. We will have a booth, so please drop by and pick up a free sweatshirt or t-shirt while supplies last. I plan to be there on Saturday from 9am to 3pm but we will have volunteers there the entire time. If you would like to volunteer, please give us a call at 804 370-8727 or email amanda@chaseforva.com.
Richmond Showmaster's Gun Show Richmond Raceway 600 East Laburnum Avenue Richmond, VA 23222
Saturday 9-5pm Sunday 10-5pm

Saturday, 5pm-8pm
Monday, March 24 We will have campaign volunteers at all of the following locations. Please stop by to sign my petition. I will be attending the Loudoun County GOP meeting.
Loudoun County 5:30pm GOP social, Mika's Neapolitan Pizza, Sterling, VA 7-8pm GOP meeting, Cascades Celebration and Corporate Event Center
Chesterfield County GOP meeting 6pm-8:30pm, Swift Creek Middle School, Midlothian, VA
Amherst County GOP meeting 6:30-8:30pm, 186 Dillard Road, Madison Heights, VA
Arlington County GOP meeting 6:30-8:30pm, The Leadership Institute, 1101 N Highland St, Arlington
Unable to attend? If you would like to sign my petition, but you are unable to attend one of these events, you can simply print off the petition, and get your family members to sign.
Please print off the petition at[ www.chaseforgovernor.com ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zTyfaXBJJgpYkSoqEiRyoyEW8GacHo7K6r7ZmghMuDAhNDO_H_R9gEh7yW66jeBl9PYqRPYq1RAIzE8HM5-_iZh1nkxL85bec6ebtE3atl8tPs6F1NxijW4KzhyUc_gg6jJ9PLOyXjXnWzfN5uRnmfQ2XVyJlutM&c=2h9sGFDWh4XlbfLiKdlhbCOuBDcyRl8-EsVwXWuNvwPACQncWcGnow==&ch=y3Fglq8ocTLiKRcnXEkdUyqXtsC5fSmylYY0f5n-BhulzXBelwGNlg==)so that it is double sided and then collect signatures, but you can't sign your own petition, witness each signature, get it notarized and Fed Ex it to our Appomattox campaign office to:
Friends of Amanda Chase 2023 Church Street #250 Appomattox, VA 24522
We still need all hands on deck. We still need to collect 400 in each Congressional District. So no matter where you live in the state, we need your help collecting signatures.
Give us a call at 804 370 8727 and we will walk you through what to do, or you can read instructions below.
Many of you are still collecting. Please go ahead and Fed Ex to us the ones that you have already signed in front of a notary, so our team can verify the signatures. It takes about 20 minutes to verify each petition.
Then, please continue collecting.
I am so impressed with the commitment level of so many of you. And I want you to know I am just as committed, working every hour of the day to collect and verify our signatures at night.
Keep this in mind. We need a minimum of 400 signatures in each Congressional District. That's about 35 pages of signatures. So please keep going to parking lots across Virginia to find gracious people willing to sign our petition.
We must collect 10,000 valid signatures, 400 in each Congressional District, and as a campaign, turn the signatures into the State Board of Elections before Thursday, April 3 at 5pm.
We would like to receive all forms before Monday, March 31, so that we can properly organize and vet the signatures before turning them in to the Virginia State Board of Elections.
Hundreds of you have reached out and are actively collecting signatures. Thank you. It's only through your efforts that my name will appear on the ballot.
Currently, our campaign is 100 percent run by volunteers in each locality. We have no paid staff. The amazing organization you've seen from my campaign is all run by volunteers who want an American First Governor, who can beat Abigail Spanberger in November.
If 500 people collect just 2 pages or 24 signatures, we meet our goal. Will you commit to helping?
Thanks to many of you who have already answered that call. If everyone does their part, you will be able to vote for me in June. If not, you won't have a choice.
We have a team of grassroots volunteers in every Congressional District across the state actively collecting signatures. To join a team in your area, please reply to this email and I will personally connect you with volunteers in your area.
In order for you to vote for me on June 17, please print off the attached petition and collect the signatures of your family, friends and neighbors, so that I can get on the ballot.
WE CANNOT COLLECT SIGNATURES ONLINE.
Signatures must be witnessed in person by signing an old fashioned paper petition ballot.
Are you ready to say yes? Here's what you need to do:

1. Print off the attached form on one sheet of paper, front and back.
2. Witness your friends, family and neighbors sign the petition form. Please make sure they actually sign the form. Please also make sure their writing is legible so that signatures can be verified.
3. Keep in mind that you can't sign your own petition form.
4. Please collect signatures by[ Congressional District.](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zTyfaXBJJgpYkSoqEiRyoyEW8GacHo7K6r7ZmghMuDAhNDO_H_R9gAAjyfbf1jy5vP9RCRW74QuxlaTlCaTd6lDykF-PBelpulpF0o8Mvyrl8o7cIrLGw0tHxW-lpoZJHNFYeyhRMBH3s0Pt7T3CunsoQj-5UlolCC6e_b4byYZu44sT031AdzBVAbl0Y-rnplolhaiufCA=&c=2h9sGFDWh4XlbfLiKdlhbCOuBDcyRl8-EsVwXWuNvwPACQncWcGnow==&ch=y3Fglq8ocTLiKRcnXEkdUyqXtsC5fSmylYY0f5n-BhulzXBelwGNlg==) One Congressional District per form. You can write the Congressional District in the upper right hand corner.
5. Get the petition notarized at your local bank for free.
6. Drop the petition off in person to: 2023 Church Street, Appomattox, VA 24522
7. Or Fed Ex the petition to:

Friends of Amanda Chase 2023 Church Street #250 Appomattox, VA 24522
Please call us at 804 370 8727 or email me at amanda@chaseforva.com if you have any questions.

---
| | Friend,As a strong conservative senior, I’m hoping that you will side with AMAC Action rather than with _the left-leaning AARP..._ By now you’ve probably heard of **billionaire globalist George Soros** and his support for the most radical leftist ideas on the planet.He’s injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, and our justice system. In the past few years, Soros has channeled millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys—including New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. What I’m about to tell you will make your blood boil—**[**but I hope it will inspire you to take action!**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zj0ajc20su0fcq5r8f4ksk54shj98gde294ojhs8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clhm4o34c3h2bs)** According to public tax filings, the left-leaning AARP accepted over **10 MILLION DOLLARS** —in just three years—from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.” **You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’** And the AARP is taking multi-millions from this group funded by the man whose life mission is to destroy our nation. It’s not hard to see why the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine, calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s “changing the world, $100 million at a time.”Friend, it makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.And listen to this...Of all age groups (including 18-29-year-olds!), when asked **“Do you have a favorable or unfavorable opinion of Donald Trump?”** —seniors aged 65 and older are the ONLY age group in America with a decreasing approval rating of President Trump.**Coincidence or Soros-backed AARP influence?****And so today I’m writing to sound the alarm.** To help President Trump usher in the **Golden Age of America** , AMAC Action must double and even triple our efforts against these radicals and George Soros’ network of prosecutors and Attorneys General who are obstructing President Trump’s America First Agenda.**_We can’t do it without brave patriots like you._** **[That’s why I’m asking you to follow this link to make a critical one-time donation today.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zl3ccumkgkmf9cnuej1kpkg124ainei3tp19qr28_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clhm4o34c3h2bs)****My friend, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action.** With its 2 million members, AMAC is the conservative antidote to the left-leaning AARP. And our 82 chapters and 348 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill. With the support of conservative seniors like you, AMAC Action has confronted the radical left at every turn. And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him. And I know that together, we can counter the poisonous ideas he’s spreading through groups like the Tides Foundation and the AARP. **Just look at what we accomplished together in 2024 alone:**
---
* **We bombarded** members of Congress, state legislators, corporate executives, and the White House with a tidal wave of emails, comments, and phone calls showing that America’s conservative seniors would not back down in the face of an overreaching Biden Admin.
* **We mobilized** seniors to get out and vote early in the battleground states, resulting in a win for President Trump in all seven swing states.
* **We organized** a massive “Hands Off My Medicare” Petition Drive to stop the Democrats’ horrible “Medicare for All” scheme from giving undocumented immigrants the same healthcare you get.
* **Together with Donald Trump, Jr.,** we united thousands of Americans around our **“Make America Strong Again”**
* **In Missouri and Kentucky,** we helped pass commonsense measures to stop non-citizens from voting in our elections.
* **We defeated** a radical pro-abortion amendment in Florida.
* **In Ohio,** we protected young girls from boys in their sports and in their bathrooms.
* **We stopped** left-wing financial institutions from “de-banking” conservatives in Tennessee simply because they don’t like their politics.

---
And our efforts are so effective that President Trump himself has put out the call for seniors to join conservative AMAC to stop the radical leftists who are ruining our country! AMAC Action isn’t going to back down and let the Left obstruct President Trump’s America First agenda. If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But we’re going to shout it from the rooftops so unsuspecting seniors know the truth!** We can’t do any of this critical work without you. **[Today—right now—when so much is at stake—will you please make a generous donation of $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500 or more?](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zaeornked3o0tc4l948cbs7b3b076aqonh5i7l88_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clhm4o34c3h2bs)** The radical Left isn’t letting up for one minute, and neither are we.**Your AMAC Action is taking every step possible to protect the interests of you and your family—but we can’t do it without you.** We already have a full agenda for the rest of this critical year that needs financing. And now that Soros has unleashed his radical D.A.s, our fights will multiply across the nation. But please know that **ANY amount** that you can contribute, whether it’s smaller or larger, is greatly appreciated. **[**Whatever you decide, please donate within the next 72 hours so we know what resources we have to work with.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2qmdot19khcf5k28efi4fslng011bfdfdgolkt8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clhm4o34c3h2bs)** If we allow radical leftists like George Soros to continue without opposition, every one of us will suffer. ## Trump Orders End to Education Department
President Trump signed an executive order Thursday aimed at [dismantling the Department of Education](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ_GdEZmjXFcuLiGLtdeiRy8DnuyAZlNuLz9ifR_N9JIn2a-P_fpHijT-vwdCnpO2wQKjFRaQjfFQPkz9U30CRFQN-g724MxHfS2WbxyblC9mi2q-eZumKwyN6NdsskabYeG_EVTGjrljDO6BeuSjSngwz2cGZzoFUbirbZ_N1p5wZQ_2xtrO2-lyX5h3g-hfwkYBYznebbz-pivUsB4oQWMSn-zgJHrq-zyoOd6SPyH84vpjXKrEasMVDDKwDLSUcLK12WJ8TUHpm2VEfdQueDKsl245Kb6uJ-UMx2DFb16lkD5O4p_kvT28D8AAP__8udpLQ) while moving some of its core functions to other departments. The order recognizes it would take an act of Congress to officially eliminate the department but it directs Education Secretary Linda McMahon to do all she can to achieve its end. Earlier this month, the department laid off nearly half of its staffers. The actions leave the department with 2,183 employees, down from 4,133 when Trump took office in January. The White House said programs providing for Pell Grants and student loans, as well as those providing for special needs children [will continue but move](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO2yAURp8Gb1j2BYwZGLp4S9eOFoZLcisMFiZx8vZVuv_bJ33S0dH5c1tvjhLl-2-3o22xrDCA4oPgMK7BUfqssgs2IgKKDu2oJSg1gtTdw25SaxBiM2GWcRJy9npS8xyVj94YjB3ZL20QMA5GGSV60CbqEB1uZjNqMkwOGKiV2v8tlNsDY_qUF9bel71L9tHacTLxi8HCYLmuq4_lnfE6vz-D5SiJGvmTwRLwcLXtmBvH8PSuUcn8pHumSN7llj480Ll_Fwae8eKtPveD4xv9s9ELeakBa1dtOC5Kic5JMzncd0fpv037qc7Lwr8AAAD__5-4axg) to other agencies.
## Hamas Fires Rockets at Israel
Fighting escalated in Gaza as Hamas fired rockets at Israel in the terrorist group’s first attack since the cease-fire collapsed this week. [Video is here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAURL8Gd0RwgTguKF5Dl9duaWFzie8uBgtQovz9yum3G-lojkbzdZ_vnhLlx3-_o-2xzCDAcKE4yDl4Su9ZD8FGREA1oJWjBmMk6HHYbDBCG6WENHH02shbAAM3XNQi1YqgBrKnTSiQYjKTURcYpziG6HGZlslcJ6YFBuqlXr4L5b5hTO_yxHpZyz4ku_V-NKb-MXAMXH4fpfUTMXCnmIET6pMZuFepKfCMr8bAbX73jUeq2Hgt6w_2xn3n1KrHxCmfqHVeYsTc6Im8UV6Rr-gbfmp8LSn5oyEDN1QbjhelRO06Mi0eu6f0Wdj_euxp4TcAAP__Z1ptOA). Israel said it intercepted one missile and two others fell in an “open area.” Hamas claimed responsibility for the bombing, saying it was in response to “the Zionist massacres against civilians” this week.

Israel launched its third day of airstrikes in Gaza overnight and into Thursday, along [with a renewed ground invasion](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn-NvWHhA-IwMHTJlq4drTMc8bXYREDj5t9X6d71-6T3pPdxna_IiffbO27kWswzSDBCKgHjHJDTc9Z9cJEISPXkxkmDMSPoqV8d6TGcYDzLqCUar41aNKAKflrOMqhzz-5FkwpGaY01aoDJxilEpMUu1pxspyUFbrkMn5n3tlJMz_ygMvi89cmtrd1rp946uHRwOY5jiPlnp6O-_teSSwodXFbcsIqE37tfqYrIpTaBraH_ElwLUhKVd0_CE1aKXEj4nBLeK_XFhfvBKXE9TZ2Wtw05_enbfzkeDn4DAAD__81iZC8). Hundreds have been reported killed in Gaza.
## Celtics Set Record with $6.1 Billion Sale
The Boston Celtics, one of the most storied teams in the NBA, have been [sold for $6.1 billion, ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb8Gd0R4MCYUFK-hy2u3tMAM8ayIsQBl5b9fOf12VzrS0dX5eiwPT5n253__QttTWUCA4kJyGJfoKZ_LNESbEAHlgHbUEyg1wqSHzXopIQSJ8j7rOyCMwUOK8yrBBBAeB7KXTUgYhVFGyRtok3RMHoMJRs2GTQIj9VJv34X2vmHKZ3ljva3lNWS79X40Jv8xcAzcfh6l9QsxcJeYgRPysxm4dpTaGwO3Yu60Nt5KjjyVymc-8kA5U9k57Xyj1kullUf0mYEbqo3Hz8XbrNkkni9P-XOg_xXkbeE3AAD__xwSYMg)setting a new record for the price of a North American sports franchise.

The new ownership group is led by Bill Chisholm, managing partner at Symphony Technology Group, along with [Boston business leaders](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAYhJ8GOw38gCwFxTV0e-2VBuFn5YKyEXaNb39x--sm800mk_m5T3eXctoe325F02KZgILsKe-BTcGlfE6iCyYiAvIODVMCpGQgVLcYzahkGEO4RTUin30QqMVNUu0EeO-7ZK42yoFRLbXkAygdVYgOZz1rOWoiKIbUyj78lrS1BWM-yxv3wZe1y2Zp7VkJ_yJgCdjjOAasz-2CBOw2OwK2trKfBOxEwKZAwArB4Salulh57R5rP6ece7-kupS89u6x42W-zt5jbsnXfmSfTCpbt5vwPC5dR0UEfawu5c-a9t87bwN_AQAA___uZGaI) Rob Hale, a current Celtics shareholder, and Bruce Beal Jr.

Former co-owner Wyc Grousbeck will remain as CEO and governor for the next three seasons. The Celtics boast a league-best 18 championships and a historic roster of legendary players, including Larry Bird, Bill Russell, and Bob Cousy. Their [epic championship battles](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQAL8Gd1h4McEUFK9xl9deaYFZx3vCJoJVIv_9KddfP5qR5uu-3ANlOh__w4Get7KAAiOVljAsKVC-lrFLfkME1B36wY5gzACj7XZvknHgboMB0GaLk7agzZSSjTGMbkod-Y9NaRiUM87oHqzbbNoCRheduTkxKkzEpfbfhU7ecctXeWHt13J02e_Mzyb0PwGzgLk9S-XWX2Ev5QMImENlWjMKmCM2lpVeIddLRuQ34iljaVxOuWJmWptUk1JaWzv1Ox-5qz4935QztZsVo3ocgfJvmP8a8fLwEwAA___CjV_6) with the Los Angeles Lakers represent one of the great rivalries in sports.

The order recognizes it would take an act of Congress to officially eliminate the department but it directs Education Secretary Linda McMahon to do all she can to achieve its end. Earlier this month, the department laid off nearly half of its staffers. The actions leave the department with 2,183 employees, down from 4,133 when Trump took office in January. The White House said programs providing for Pell Grants and student loans, as well as those providing for special needs children to other agencies. Hamas Fires Rockets at Israel Fighting escalated in Gaza as Hamas fired rockets at Israel in the terrorist group’s first attack since the cease-fire collapsed this week. . Israel said it intercepted one missile and two others fell in an “open area.” Hamas claimed responsibility for the bombing, saying it was in response to “the Zionist massacres against civilians” this week. Israel launched its third day of airstrikes in Gaza overnight and into Thursday, along . Hundreds have been reported killed in Gaza. Celtics Set Record with $6.1 Billion Sale The Boston Celtics, one of the most storied teams in the NBA, have been a new record for the price of a North American sports franchise. The new ownership group is led by Bill Chisholm, managing partner at Symphony Technology Group, along with Rob Hale, a current Celtics shareholder, and Bruce Beal Jr. Former co-owner Wyc Grousbeck will remain as CEO and governor for the next three seasons. The Celtics boast a league-best 18 championships and a historic roster of legendary players, including Larry Bird, Bill Russell, and Bob Cousy. | | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

Friend, we are in the final stretch so I’ll get straight to the point.
In less than**2 weeks** we will know who will win the biggest Special Election of 2025. Election Day for**Florida’s 6th Congressional District** is on **April 1st** and Democrats have already poured in millions to chip away at the GOP House Majority.
They are hoping that Republicans drop the ball in the Sunshine State and**right now the polls are neck-and-neck** because of the war chest being spent against me.
With a razor thin majority in the House everything is on the line. Everything that we fought for in last year’s election may go up in smoke if President Trump doesn’t have allies in Congress to help deliver the America First vision that we voted for.
**We need to stop just watching President Trump and start fighting for his agenda.**
When I get to Congress that is exactly what I’ll do but I need your help to get there. I need reinforcements to get over the finish line and I am humbly asking for your support.

subject: I’m done playing nice
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VIVEK RAMASWAMY FOR OHIO
body:
This is a common-sense revolution.

This is a common-sense revolution.
It's simple: if you're not performing, you're not getting paid
| |
---
| | | | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---

Peter,

The failed education bureaucracy in America had its chance to get it right. And what do we have to show for it? A system that rewards tenure over performance, promotes victimhood, and lowers standards to paper over failure.

Meanwhile, our children are left to suffer the consequences.

**Today, 70% of U.S. 8th graders are NOT proficient in reading. That 's unacceptable. As Governor, I'll take a wrecking ball to the entire system. **

I won't play nice with the entrenched special interests holding our children back. It's time to build a new system that rewards EXCELLENCE. Ohio will be the first state in the nation to implement merit-based pay for public school teachers.

Teaching is a noble profession. And if you're a rockstar educator who's getting results, you can expect to be compensated handsomely for your excellence. On the other hand, low performers will no longer climb the ladder like everyone else.

This isn't a partisan issue. This is a common-sense revolution that will change the future of education.

But the education bureaucracy won't go down without a fight. Neither will the corrupt teacher's unions. They'll throw everything they've got at us to try and stop this reform from EVER happening. That's why I need your support.

Will you help us fix our education crisis?
**[SIGN MY PETITION: Institute merit-based pay for public school teachers!](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-E83TTLHA "SIGN MY PETITION: Institute merit-based pay for public school teachers!")**

---
| | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-S-OTqac1DA)

And if you're as fed up as I am with the failed status quo, **[consider making a contribution to our campaign today.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._ObJ56Cwlk6PAHv8YUQ "consider making a contribution to our campaign today.")** We're not just fighting for education reform - we're fighting for the future of our state.

It's time to take a stand and fight for what's right. Join me in this revolution to transform our system and give our children the education they deserve.

God Bless you and God Bless America,

Vivek Ramaswamy
Candidate for Governor of Ohio

## THC Ban Passes Texas Senate
The Texas Senate passed legislation Wednesday to [ban all products containing THC](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FugzAQQL_GbEb22QQYPHRhS9eO6PAdwapjI-yG5O-rdO_-9J7e13W-Yogh3T7xzq4-1zyDgk4qI0HPhCG-ZtuQWxSNumGnewtdZwcYms2NA43UaQI7cj8sZIwBo1dk06NfiJvg3jJlQGvVDerSquHCvh-tZbZjt7KwiinUfLR148pPLGt85Qcfrc_3Jrqt1r0I8yFgEjCd59mu-dnjT6khvREBU-KzCJgIk9yxHsF_ywfuLMuW9yKJY0VZNy89poRLKM3haD9DjKFcemHV7Y4h_uXqv_8PB78BAAD__3VAXto), the psychoactive ingredient in marijuana. Since 2019, sales of consumable hemp products containing less than 0.3% THC have been legal, and more than 8,300 shops selling THC-infused beverages, gummies, and vapes have popped up around the state. Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick has prioritized passage of Senate Bill 3, arguing that many hemp retailers prey on young people and sell products with a THC concentration [well above the legal limit](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuOgzAQRb_GdEbjwRBTuNjGXbbdEk3wEKyYh2wrJH-_ItKWWx_dh87PdbhSiGG9f9PCtrymbUDAVkIjUQ2eQnwPuvL2Br5XFVt10di22qCpZttNrUGe2KhRkZ_Q0KjBo7pRPxpgroI9y6BBpaA10NVgOh4vvdbMum8nFhrYh7Klusxc-EV5iu_tyaket6WKdi5lz6L5EugEuuM46kemckKBbuUjC3SfmEB3Tgl00Ah0qv8DMvNKheVOOXOWMy-7vNEqSXpa5U4lhfEh9xS2FMpboKuS9fsRYgy5uwgN94VC_Nwp__p5WvwNAAD__ydWZ4A), causing an increase in addiction and mental health issues among consumers. "_This is a poison in our public_ ," Patrick said. Advocates for the hemp industry insist the sale of illegal products is not widespread and are pushing for tighter regulations, arguing an outright ban would forfeit billions in tax revenue, eliminate around 50,000 jobs, and force consumers to turn to the black market. On Tuesday, the 74-year-old Patrick visited The Happy Cactus, a hemp store in Austin, where he was [asked for his ID](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOqzAQAL_GdKD1YsAULl5Dl9deiYy9xKtzsGWskPz9KddfPdKM5uu23ixHPu7_7YNMfe1pRcChhb5FuXrL8b2qxpsN_CwbMnJSOAxKo26CUYgKN43a7V5OvRocAmkYPe0wb1Y2bD4y6FFKGDSMHeiR3DQrRaTmYSehgDzXVLoaqNLLnnt8pyeVzqVHE02oNZ-i_ydwEbhc19W5UNLxoQKXnCJXdqfAxZbKLpLAxdujzbYWdt9tDa7d7NEiYA_9hF0OuSnG54tj5HOchIL7w3L8zdU__58GfwIAAP__XslcIw) upon entry. [Senate Bill 3](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DFv8jAQxvFP42xE5_MlxIOHF6HoHaBDGTpGjnMOVk0dxS4l376CvftPzyP9P87D2YYYvuY3e2NTHj4NCNjsQO1QDpMNcRuomswIk5YVG7knbBrqsKuupmtHLcG1DiSPo_ajpQY8sRs9sSRdBfMcA4VSQtNBW0PXsttrImbSjWdBwFMoaa3LlQs_bPZxS3dea5duVTTXUpYs1D-BvcDe2SWUFOsXrOd0F9gfQoynlD6_F4H9_5BLWrfa5uUhVH_i-cI5C3Xs9LvA9mmFOl4OqlrNtPyEGENu94JgvtkQX5_lzwh3g78BAAD__98YXlE) passed in a bipartisan 24-7 vote and awaits consideration in the House, where seperate legislation has been filed to regulate consumable hemp products rather than ban them altogether. That bill's author, Sen. Charles Perry (R-Lubbock), insists the two chambers are “philosophically aligned” on the issue.
## Paxton Sues Coppell ISD Over CRT
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton is [suing Coppell ISD](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j71uwyAURp8Gb1hww48ZGLp4S9eOFoFLgkqMZWhw3r5y927f8Okcna_rcnUpp_X-6Z5o2xHLAgwkZRcKfAku5fcihmBvLBg-oOVagJRigml42DhpY5xhRiuH-sYjhiCd8lpJgJsPQ7InjF2AcyYnpkY2KfTaCIEojIxIBMOQWtnH9sCGh6sxv8sL99GX55Dto7WtkssHgZnA3HsfYznEir2eBwLzOQnMvmwb5kxTDdTvjWbX609q9BtXurmjlXXYbdh6yjlVpYlg96dL-c_S_s1-WfgNAAD__yuPW7k) for allegedly violating the state's ban on teaching critical race theory (CRT), citing an undercover video in which an administrator says that “despite what our state standards say,” the district has “gotten around” the ban and does “what’s right for kids.” The video was obtained by watchdog group Accuracy in Media and [shared last month](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uKjEQQOGn8XagmdnxX-EC3avtSJtyZdZjsGRYtHYIvH1E-rSn-KTzeZyPsdRyO3_Eq4T-zOtMQHoH445wTrHU18xDCidIHgcJaJm0ZkduuASddLLa5OwXtFE7D3RyYkfmbBbENJTwxmAkRNAOzB6ckcV6ZhH2OotikFT6uu37Rbo8Y8v1tT5k2y_rdajh0vu9qfGgaFI0Pd9V0fRfDrez1NL-rZu8FE2tx_7VFE3oPGsgtoAekdiMZthCun-XWkszVjGcr7HUX77_-fsI9BMAAP__DP5UXA) by school choice advocate Corey DeAngelis. It shows Evan Whitfield, Coppell ISD’s director of curriculum and instruction, responding to the undercover journalist’s question about the “version of history” taught in the classroom. "_We just do the right thing at the end of the day_ ," Whitfield said, explaining that the district has dismissed allegations of promoting CRT by insisting "_we’re just not teaching that_." name: History Facts
subject: Portable music players are older than you'd think
body:
Long before the Walkman and iPod, there was the Mikiphone. Invented in 1924 by Hungarian siblings Miklós and Étienne Vadász, the Mikiphone was a portable record player designed to be compact enough to fit into a pocket or purse.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68e8jve15u9jen6q58id8uqn2e1lep6qgstt5x42i3z6svh9x1sdrxbovoekk4bwitszoecbwbs1uvsonxh5p46gag1h7ucc35qnga5xgz201t7na3uekkqfbog97kjdd9zyrb84b3otqil14&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
---
---
# [The first portable music player was invented in 1924.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| L ong before the Walkman and iPod, there was the Mikiphone. Invented in 1924 by Hungarian siblings Miklós and Étienne Vadász, the [Mikiphone](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was a portable record player designed to be compact enough to fit into a pocket or purse. It featured a turntable, a tonearm with a needle, and a circular metal resonator that amplified the sound in place of a traditional phonograph’s horn. No power supply was needed — an internal spring drive mechanism rotated the turntable. Everything folded up into a round metal case that measured just over 4 inches across and just under 2 inches thick, more closely resembling an oversized pocket watch than a miniature gramophone.
---
The Mikiphone was manufactured by Swiss company Paillard, which was known for its watches and music boxes. Advertisements [at the time](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) called the music player a “marvel of compactness” and boasted it was “ideal for picnics, car jaunts, [and] river trips.” Ads even [extolled](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) it as “literally the Eighth Wonder of the World.” It was indeed novel for its time, but despite its small size, the device was ultimately a bit cumbersome. The Mikiphone required that several parts — including small pieces such as the [needle and the record weight](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) — be carefully assembled and disassembled for each use, and when put together, it primarily played 10-inch, 78 RPM records — hardly a pocket-sized piece of media. Between 1925 and 1927, Paillard manufactured around 180,000 units, but by 1928 sales had plummeted, and Mikiphones were being let go at a major discount as a discontinued product. Today, the Mikiphone is known as the originator of portable music and is a [prized collectible](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com).

## The Walkman was originally called the “Soundabout” in the U.S.
When Sony released its revolutionary portable cassette player, it wasn’t universally known as the Walkman. In the United States, the device was called the “[Soundabout](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sth06k&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)”; in the U.K. it was called the “Stowaway”; and in Australia, it was the “Freestyle.” At the time, retail companies outside Sony’s home in Japan thought “Walkman” wasn’t right for Western markets — another suggested name for the U.S. market was “Sony Disco Jogger.” But the Walkman name had already gained traction in Japan, where, upon the player’s 1979 release, early sales far exceeded expectations: Sony predicted moving 5,000 units a month, but the Walkman sold upwards of 50,000 in just the first two months. In 1980, Sony co-founder Akio Morita decided the Walkman name would be used worldwide, though advertisements show the Soundabout moniker held on in the U.S. for another few years.

name: Dominic Rapini
subject: Only We The People Vote
body:
Citizenship Matters

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c5dc36f035c0/when-we-vote-we-win-14762679?e=8763c56857)
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | | “The right to vote is the crown jewel of American liberties, and we will not see its luster diminished.”
— Ronald Reagan, 40th President of the United States
---
|
---
| **Only ‘We The People’ Vote** _**Citizenship Matters**_
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=cc8d51b26f&e=8763c56857)
---
| _**By Dominic Rapini, American Businessman and Political Commentator**_
**The Ballot Box: For Citizens Only, Please**
In the grand theater of democracy, the right to vote is the star of the show—a privilege earned by those who pledge allegiance to the nation. Yet, a curious subplot has emerged: the push to extend voting rights to non-citizens. While inclusivity is a noble goal, allowing non-citizens to vote threatens the very foundation of our sovereignty and diminishes the value of citizenship.
**A Brief Tour of Non-Citizen Voting Initiatives**
Let’s embark on a journey across the United States, where various locales have flirted with the idea of non-citizen voting:
• **New York City: In 2021,** the city council passed a law permitting over 800,000 legal non-citizens to vote in municipal elections. However, this law was struck down by the state’s Court of Appeals in 2025, which ruled it unconstitutional, emphasizing that voting is a right reserved for citizens.
• **Washington, D.C.** : Our nation’s capital allows non-citizens, including undocumented immigrants, to vote in local elections. This means foreign nationals can influence policies in the very heart of our country—a scenario that should make any patriot’s eyebrows rise.
• **San Francisco, California:** The city permits non-citizens, specifically parents or guardians of school-aged children, to vote in school board elections. While education is vital, allowing non-citizens to vote on public matters sets a concerning precedent.
• **Maryland and Vermont:** Several municipalities in these states have opened local election voting to non-citizens, further muddying the waters of electoral integrity.
**Connecticut’s Foray into Non-Citizen Voting**
Closer to home, Connecticut has seen proposals to amend its constitution to allow non-citizens to vote in state and municipal elections. State Representative Juan Candelaria introduced such a bill in 2023 and 2024, aiming to grant voting rights to the estimated**240,000 immigrants in the state** , half of whom are undocumented. While the bill was unlikely to pass, it sparked a debate on the essence of citizenship and voting rights.
**The Slippery Slope to Sovereignty Erosion**
Allowing non-citizens to vote is akin to handing over the keys of your house to a neighbor—no matter how friendly—without expecting them to respect your rules. Voting is not just a civic duty; it’s a cornerstone of self-determination. When non-citizens influence local policies, it dilutes the voice of actual citizens and undermines the concept of a government**“by the people, for the people.”**
**The Call to Action**
Fellow citizens, it’s time to stand firm. The right to vote is a privilege that comes with citizenship—a bond that ties us to our nation’s destiny. Let’s ensure that this sacred privelige remains exclusive to those who have committed themselves to the United States. Engage in local discussions, reach out to your representatives, and advocate for policies that uphold the sanctity of citizenship. Together, we can safeguard our democracy and ensure a bright future for all Americans.
Remember, in the grand play of democracy, only citizens should have a speaking role at the ballot box.
Let’s keep it that way.

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39556%2E3422442%2EnkifFl)
Hi Derek,
I don’t take it for granted when someone chips in to my campaign. It is your hard-earned money, and it really does make a difference.
**[I’m going to share more, but first, will you donate $5 or $10 to help me become California’s next governor?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250321_1_ak?refcode=em20250321-39556&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39556_3422442_nkifFl&akid=39556%2E3422442%2EnkifFl)**
When you boil it down, campaigns are won through voter contact. We’re trying to persuade voters to choose us and/or to convince people to actually vote instead of staying home.
These efforts take resources, whether it’s paying for ads, hiring staff to organize media appearances, or enlisting volunteers to knock doors or make calls.
When many campaign budgets are in the millions, it can be hard to wrap your head around what your donation actually means. I’ve crunched the numbers to tell you exactly what your $5 can buy a campaign:
* 250 digital ad impressions
* 8 pieces of mail
* 10 doors canvassed (you can increase this number by volunteering!)

Now, multiply that by thousands and thousands of people chipping in, and you’ve got the recipe for a winning campaign.
I’m proud to have run every single one of my campaigns with only grassroots contributions, and this time is no different. **[So I have to ask, will you chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can spare to help me reach voters and win in 2026?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250321_1_ak?refcode=em20250321-39556&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39556_3422442_nkifFl&akid=39556%2E3422442%2EnkifFl)**
Thanks,
Katie

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20250321-39556&amounts=&t=3&refcode2=39556_3422442_nkifFl&akid=39556%2E3422442%2EnkifFl)**

body:
The American people are united on this issue. Yet...
#

Friends -
There is a lot of division on issues across this country, but one thing Americans are united on across the ideological spectrum is the need for universal background checks on gun sales.
We know that.
But did you know there are Republicans working overtime to weaken our background checks system?
It's not something they talk about in ads or on social media, because it's deeply unpopular.
But the gun lobby and those who do their bidding want nothing more than to eliminate commonsense background checks and sell as many guns as possible.
This is not hyperbole.
They've done it for years. They've tried to repeal rules that notify the background checks system when someone has been deemed unfit to manage their affairs because of mental illness. They want to loosen regulations about who is considered to be "engaged in the business" of selling firearms and required to perform a background check at the point of sale. And on and on it goes.
One of our top priorities over the next term of Congress and Trump's presidency must be protecting our background checks system as best we can.
But GIFFORDS relies on the support of people like you to help us advance our cause in the courts and in state legislatures, and to get the message out widely when Republicans overstep.
So while we know you probably didn't wake up today and think you were going to make a donation to GIFFORDS, that's what we're asking you to do:

Friends - There is a lot of division on issues across this country, but one thing Americans are united on across the ideological spectrum is the need for universal background checks on gun sales. We know that. But did you know there are Republicans working overtime to weaken our background checks system? It's not something they talk about in ads or on social media, because it's deeply unpopular. But the gun lobby and those who do their bidding want nothing more than to eliminate commonsense background checks and sell as many guns as possible. This is not hyperbole. They've done it for years. They've tried to repeal rules that notify the background checks system when someone has been deemed unfit to manage their affairs because of mental illness. They want to loosen regulations about who is considered to be "engaged in the business" of selling firearms and required to perform a background check at the point of sale. And on and on it goes. | | | | Friends,

Next week, With Honor Action is celebrating the five-year anniversary of the release of the National Commission on Military, National, and Public Service’s final report: an important reflection on the state of service and civic engagement across America. The Commission’s recommendations aimed to elevate service as a foundation of American democracy, expand pathways to national and public service, and modernize the Selective Service System to better meet today’s challenges.
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=b77b178d2e&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| 🔗 You can read the full report [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=8cb5b85fb7&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
|
---
| **Five Years of Progress**
The Commission’s 2020 report set key objectives, including expanding national service opportunities, strengthening civic education, and improving access to military and public service careers. While notable progress has been made, further efforts are required to fully achieve the vision of universal service for all Americans.

➡ Where we stand today:

📈 Interest in national service participation has grown. According to a [2021 poll](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=378fa5b532&e=33f53a5b1a) that With Honor commissioned, **an average of 71% of young adults have either considered or enrolled in AmeriCorps**.

🎓 According to [AmeriCorps’ 2025 National Service Report](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=d4e5dbebec&e=33f53a5b1a), the **Segal AmeriCorps Education Award was given to to nearly 60,000 AmeriCorps alumni** , continuing its support for those pursuing higher education or repaying student loans.

🎖️ Plans to **expand JROTC from the current 3,275 units to at least 3,500 units are underway** , with a longer-term goal of reaching 4,100 programs nationwide.
---
|
---
The leaders of the Peace Corps, Selective Service System, and AmeriCorps speaking with the bipartisan, veterans-only For Country Caucus in the House of Representatives
| **Join Us in Advocating for Universal Service**
At **With Honor Action** , we believe that service is a unifying force that strengthens our democracy and bridges divides. As we mark **five years since the Commission’s report** , we celebrate the progress made while recognizing the work that remains. Expanding national service, modernizing the Selective Service System, and fostering civic engagement are essential to building a nation where every American has the opportunity to serve and make an impact.

We are committed to advancing policies that increase access to service, invest in leadership development, and ensure that national service remains a vital part of the American experience.

🔗 Join the conversation and get involved here: [With Honor Action](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=03ae60a93f&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
|
---
With Honor Action Advisory Board Member former Senator Barbara Mikulski is often called the "Godmother of National Service" for her leadership on the establishment of AmeriCorps.

The Commission’s recommendations aimed to elevate service as a foundation of American democracy, expand pathways to national and public service, and modernize the Selective Service System to better meet today’s challenges. | | 🔗 You can read the full report | | Five Years of Progress The Commission’s 2020 report set key objectives, including expanding national service opportunities, strengthening civic education, and improving access to military and public service careers. While notable progress has been made, further efforts are required to fully achieve the vision of universal service for all Americans. ➡ Where we stand today: 📈 Interest in national service participation has grown. According to a that With Honor commissioned, an average of 71% of young adults have either considered or enrolled in AmeriCorps. 🎓 According to , the Segal AmeriCorps Education Award was given to to nearly 60,000 AmeriCorps alumni , continuing its support for those pursuing higher education or repaying student loans. 🎖️ Plans to expand JROTC from the current 3,275 units to at least 3,500 units are underway , with a longer-term goal of reaching 4,100 programs nationwide. | The leaders of the Peace Corps, Selective Service System, and AmeriCorps speaking with the bipartisan, veterans-only For Country Caucus in the House of Representatives | Join Us in Advocating for Universal Service At With Honor Action , we believe that service is a unifying force that strengthens our democracy and bridges divides. As we mark five years since the Commission’s report , we celebrate the progress made while recognizing the work that remains. Expanding national service, modernizing the Selective Service System, and fostering civic engagement are essential to building a nation where every American has the opportunity to serve and make an impact. GOP Rep. Tom Emmer **[clashed with CNN's Pamela Brown](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d4a52c-8789-4895-a114-e4f6bde22b8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for unfairly lashing into Trump and his agenda for America during a heated live interview.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d4a52c-8789-4895-a114-e4f6bde22b8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d4a52c-8789-4895-a114-e4f6bde22b8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I know that you're a big supporter of President Trump of course," Brown told Emmer. "But he has tested the boundaries of presidential power. And now seeming to want to do away with checks and balances,... freezing funds appropriated by congress, wanting to get rid of birthright citizenship, firing federal trade commissioners when there is Supreme Court precedent saying a president can't do it. **[What do you think about all that?" ](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d4a52c-8789-4895-a114-e4f6bde22b8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Emmer couldn't get 2 words out before being interrupted. "This is a narrative that the media is trying to create..."
"No!" Brown inserted. "Just to be respectful Whip Emmer, it's not a narrative, I just pointed out specific examples!"
**["I'm going to be respectful too!"](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d4a52c-8789-4895-a114-e4f6bde22b8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Emmer shot back. "But when you don;t talk about the Dobbs decision that Joe Biden viciously attacked our Supreme Court because he disagreed with it, and you make this look like something it's not, Trump's not happy, I'm sure, but what it comes to what6 he's trying to do, there are 77 million Americans that elected him to do exactly what he's doing!!"
Brown had to back peddle after that. Watch what happened next in the tense live interview:
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/a6d4a52c-8789-4895-a114-e4f6bde22b8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
