# Marco Rubio ERUPTS at woke CBS host for defending pro-terrorist Ivy League student
Secretary of State Marco Rubio **[went off at CBS's Margaret Brennan](https://substack.com/redirect/cb4af760-e214-4fe1-b546-58e51321979e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during a discussion on whether Columbia University student and anti-Israel protester Mahmoud Khalil should be deported for his alleged support of the terrorist group Hamas.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/cb4af760-e214-4fe1-b546-58e51321979e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/cb4af760-e214-4fe1-b546-58e51321979e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"If you tell us when you apply for a visa 'I'm coming to the U.S. to participate in pro-Hamas events,' that runs counter to the foreign policy interests of the United States, it's that simple," Rubio explained the Brennan. "You lied! If you had told us your were going to do that we never would have given you the visa! Now you're here, you do it, you lied to us, you're out! It's that simple."
**["But is there any evidence of a link to terrorism](https://substack.com/redirect/cb4af760-e214-4fe1-b546-58e51321979e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** or is it just his point of view?" Brennan countered.
"You should watch the news!" Rubio said, flabbergasted by her comment. "These guys take over entire buildings, they vandalize colleges, they shut down colleges!!"
"We don't need these people in our country! We never should have allowed them in in the first place!"
Khalil was allegedly involved in distributing pro-Hamas propaganda at Columbia University and taking part in the destructive anti-Israel demonstrations on campus.
"The bottom line is this," Rubio snapped. **["We don't want terrorists in America! I don't know why that's hard to understand!" ](https://substack.com/redirect/cb4af760-e214-4fe1-b546-58e51321979e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Watch Rubio go off on Brennan for trying to defend Khalil's right to stay in the U.S.:
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/cb4af760-e214-4fe1-b546-58e51321979e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

**By Rudy Giuliani**
Listen up, folks--America is under attack, not just from abroad but from within, and it's time we take a stand. The case of Mahmoud Khalil, a Columbia University student and anti-Israel agitator, is a glaring example of what's wrong with letting radicals infiltrate our country and our elite institutions. This guy's not here to contribute to the American dream--he's here to tear it down, and he's gotta go. President Trump's got it right: deporting Khalil is the first step in rooting out pervasive anti-Semitism and protecting our values.
Let's get one thing straight: Israel is our ally, one of the strongest we've got. They're a democracy in a sea of chaos, standing shoulder-to-shoulder with us against terrorism and tyranny. Our government's support for Israel isn't up for debate--it's a bedrock of our foreign policy, forged through decades of shared struggle and mutual respect. If your whole purpose for being here is to protest that alliance, to undermine it with hate and lies, then you don't belong in the United States. Pack your bags, Mahmoud--Syria's waiting.
Now, let's talk facts. Khalil wasn't just some kid with a sign at a rally. This guy was a ringleader, a graduate student at Columbia who turned that campus into a cesspool of anti-Israel venom. He distributed propaganda--right there on American soil--celebrating the October 7th attacks, that barbaric assault by Hamas that slaughtered over 1,100 innocent people, including women and children...

[1]Justice Democrats

Elon Musk won’t stop until America’s federal government and best public
services are destroyed, Peter:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20250321-dont-privatize-amtrak-usps/?source=em20250321-36522&akid=36522%2E1203867%2E1QE6Fl ]Reuters: Elon Musk says Post Office, Amtrak should be privatized. Mar
6, 2025 — “I think logically we should privatize anything that can
reasonably be privatized,” Musk said at a Morgan Stanley conference.

The unelected billionaire and head of DOGE has already infiltrated
multiple federal agencies and attempted to cut funding to the bone while
conducting mass firings of thousands of workers. His cuts to USAID are
already having deadly impacts.

Now, it’s no surprise Musk wants to come for Amtrak and the U.S. Postal
Service — two of our most popular and important public services — and turn
them into private businesses to make a profit.

If Musk and DOGE were serious about cutting waste, they should start at
the Pentagon, which has failed 7 audits in a row and has a $850 billion
budget for corporate defense contractors, rather than Amtrak, which is
posting record ridership for everyday people. Or they could look at Tesla,
SpaceX, and Starlink — Musk’s companies have gorged themselves on more
than 38 billion dollars in government contracts since 2008.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20250321-dont-privatize-amtrak-usps/?source=em20250321-36522&akid=36522%2E1203867%2E1QE6Fl ]We can’t let DOGE take a chainsaw to critical public services like
these. Will you add your name to our petition demanding Democrats defend

What's my favorite book? That's a question I am often asked, and it's become harder to answer these past few years. The titles and authors I've named for decades come readily to mind, but I've started to wonder if those answers are still true. It's been years since I've read some of them, and while they appealed to the teenage or undergraduate version of me, I wondered if they still would now that I am an adult. I have a friend - big Hemingway fan - who recently told me that he never cared for _The Old Man and the Sea_ when he read it in high school, but when he re-read it in middle-age, it landed a lot differently.
And so last summer, at the active encouragement of my good friend Worth Wray, I reread _Atlas Shrugged_. I rediscovered Objectivism and quickly became intellectually obsessed with Ayn Rand's thinking. I reread the books of my youth, tearing through _Anthem_ and _The Virtues of Selfishness, We the Living,_ and _Capitalism_. Her insights into class warfare, tyranny, freedom, and the distinction between producers and looters now had an urgent relevance that I didn't recall in my college reading of her work.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..yoFZtcOyZvhe1Hte_PXSh76xqEpk1_iDQ0trYGzJJuI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=159520832)
In much of Western culture, the capitalist is often portrayed as a villain, exploiting workers for his personal gain. For Rand, the businessman who created and built and hired was the hero of the story; production was the greatest virtue. And Rand saw business as a unique bulwark against tyranny. She [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/794f9d98-049f-4637-8de7-2f32bb10263f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that while other professions exist in totalitarian societies - politicians, farmers, teachers, scientists, soldiers - businessmen do not. Businessmen are what distinguish capitalist from statist societies, and Rand saw them as the ultimate symbol of freedom. One of her key messages was that there was a massive difference between businessmen who produce and bureaucrats who live off the production of others.
**While other professions exist in totalitarian societies - politicians, farmers, teachers, scientists, soldiers - businessmen do not. Businessmen are what distinguish capitalist from statist societies...**
Rediscovering Rand was one of the reasons I decided to start a business last fall, something I wrote about in my last post. I had written and thought and taught about business. I had advised and served on the boards of some of the largest companies in the world. I had even started a few small businesses, usually focused on ideas and the abstract (I had often referred to myself as an "entrepreneur of ideas"). It was time to start and run a business that created something tangible and concrete, while also creating jobs.
And hence I formed [Goodwell Foods](https://substack.com/redirect/845ad66e-032e-4fd6-84c5-2f0a7cd73c3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a private label frozen pizza manufacturer located in Pittsfield, NH that now employs several dozen people. We went from standing still to sprinting at full speed in a matter of days. And with a focus on production embedded throughout our team, our output and productivity grow almost every day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce2f9e75-4544-4d84-8ed8-3dd3fcb5a8d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..yoFZtcOyZvhe1Hte_PXSh76xqEpk1_iDQ0trYGzJJuI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=159520832)
That's the key word: productivity. I feel productive. It feels good to produce, to lead a team united in purpose, to create value and put pizza on a store's shelf and ultimately on a family's table. Throughout my life I've come to know brilliant entrepreneurs and businesspeople who created lots of jobs and wealth. I've seen the positive impact they had on the lives of thousands of people. That's why Rand's writing is landing a little different in middle-age than it did in my youth.
For Rand, business was an intellectual and spiritual pursuit. She [saw](https://substack.com/redirect/7dd7d128-33fa-4555-b44d-6a18b0053bfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the businessman as, "...a great liberator who, in the short span of a century and a half, has released men from bondage to their physical needs, has released them from the terrible drudgery of an eighteen-hour workday of manual labor for their barest subsistence, has released them from famines, from pestilences, from the stagnant hopelessness and terror in which most of mankind had lived in all of the pre-capitalist centuries - and in which most of it still lives, in non-capitalist countries."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/de2d7aaa-dcf1-4527-92d1-f4d1f41638c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
By Buster7 - Own work, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?curid=40696763
I've always believed in the value of service. For me, starting a new company isn't just about dollars and cents, although we hope to do well. It's also about doing good. I have taught and guided students; I have been active in politics, trying to effect positive change; I have been an advocate for those with special needs; I've taught adaptive skiing to disabled vets and kids. I am proud of the work that I have done in my community but have also realized I can do even more good in business.
Businesspeople and entrepreneurs - far from the greedy, self-interested stereotype - are truly the ones providing a community service. They actually can make the world a better place. Capitalism has, after all, pulled more people from poverty than any non-profit organization ever has (or will).
And hence, the name, Goodwell Foods. We are going to do both good and well.

As I write this Amnesty reports that Netanyahu has unilaterally broken the January 19 ceasefire, [killing 400 Palestinians in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/1f7912d5-a1b5-42be-a451-a4ba1cbc853d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and hospitalizing 550 more. And as Netanyahu promises to continue bombing Gaza, corporate media like the LA Times is elevating articles further demonizing Palestinians.
In an article titled, "_Mahmoud Khalil isn 't a citizen. His deportation wouldn't be unlawful_," the LA Times publishes a self-described "Pro Jewish nationalist and Christian nationalist." The author argues for the abolition of due process, argues against our Constitutional principles of equal justice, and horrifyingly, repeats fascist talking points that earlier pundits and politicians used to justify genocide, ethnic cleansing, and war crimes against Jewish people, Japanese Americans, Black Americans, and Indigenous Americans.
The author flat out lies or misrepresents the truth at least 20 times--and the LA Times decided to publish it anyway, without so much as a fact check. Given the LA Times size and influence, [that their owner is a pro-Trump billionaire](https://substack.com/redirect/5fe18cc8-5286-49b1-ab9c-4b7ce8f03ebf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and given the emails I've received from readers asking if what the LA Times piece argues is true--I write today to debunk this fascist propaganda, piece by piece.

## Conclusion
The LA Times' reckless publication of blatant propaganda is yet another reminder that corporate media is not here to inform--it is here to manipulate. When a newspaper with the reach and influence of the LA Times elevates fascist rhetoric, smears a man without evidence, and actively justifies the erosion of due process, it ceases to be journalism and becomes state-sponsored disinformation. It's one more reason [why I ask for your support](https://substack.com/redirect/0c8dd1cb-db82-42e9-a24e-286681c72dfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to help push back against these destructive narratives.
If we don't push back, this won't stop at Mahmoud Khalil. We have seen this before--as described above--and the pattern is clear: dehumanization, criminalization, and then, with the public sufficiently primed, outright genocide. That's how fascism takes hold. And this is why we cannot allow this disinformation to go unchallenged.
Our Constitution guarantees due process of law for a reason. It exists to shield the vulnerable from government overreach and political persecution. If we let this slide because we think it does not affect us, we are signing off on our own silence when the next person--maybe someone we love--is labeled an "enemy" and stripped of their rights without evidence.
We do not have to accept this and we are not powerless--at least not yet. We can hold these institutions accountable, demand facts over propaganda, and refuse to let disinformation dictate our democracy. The fight for justice is ongoing, but history shows us that when we organize, resist, and refuse to back down--we win.
Let us make sure that, once again, we win, and save Western civilization by upholding justice and due process, not fear and hate.

We cannot leave unanswered these 20 published lies about the US Government's illegal abduction of Mahmoud Khalil Mar 21 | | | | | | | | | | | As I write this Amnesty reports that Netanyahu has unilaterally broken the January 19 ceasefire, , and hospitalizing 550 more. And as Netanyahu promises to continue bombing Gaza, corporate media like the LA Times is elevating articles further demonizing Palestinians. In an article titled, "Mahmoud Khalil isn 't a citizen. His deportation wouldn't be unlawful," the LA Times publishes a self-described "Pro Jewish nationalist and Christian nationalist." The author argues for the abolition of due process, argues against our Constitutional principles of equal justice, and horrifyingly, repeats fascist talking points that earlier pundits and politicians used to justify genocide, ethnic cleansing, and war crimes against Jewish people, Japanese Americans, Black Americans, and Indigenous Americans. The author flat out lies or misrepresents the truth at least 20 times--and the LA Times decided to publish it anyway, without so much as a fact check. Given the LA Times size and influence, , and given the emails I've received from readers asking if what the LA Times piece argues is true--I write today to debunk this fascist propaganda, piece by piece. Let 's Address This. As corporate media continues to fail us, I 'm doing everything in my power to hold the powerful accountable. I cannot do it alone. Join our movement and subscribe below. | | ---|---|--- Protestors gather to demand the release of Mahmoud Khalil at Foley Square on March 10, 2025 in New York City. (Photo by David Dee Delgado/Getty Images) This article's structure is simple. I cite the LA Times claim in bold , then cite the receipts to debunk said claim. I am hopeful you find these receipts valuable in your dialogues to rebuke fascist propaganda, misinformation, and disinformation. The article begins with a detached intro complaining about the stock market (), DOGE (), Iran and nuclear weapons (made possible by even as ), and claiming that Russia and Ukraine are close to a ceasefire (). It then finally arrives at its apparent point--demonizing Mahmoud Khalil to justify his illegal abduction and detainment. Brace yourself, because the LA Times propaganda is unhinged. 1. Claim: Media consumers probably don 'tcare a lot about whether a Syrian national and Algerian citizen who was the face of last year 's pro-Hamas Columbia University campus riots gets deported. Fact: On the contrary, immigration ended up being the . This was mainly because Trump convinced enough voters that immigrants were harming America, when in reality every study-- that immigrants immensely benefit the United States. The LA Times then smears Khalil as "the face of pro-Hamas riots." There's zero evidence of this claim. If there were evidence, the US Government would have loudly proclaimed it from every media outlet imaginable. But despite repeated requests by dozens of journalists, Khalil's lawyer, and the public for such evidence, the US Government has provided nothing. Moreover, Jews stood shoulder to shoulder with Khalil during the Columbia protests. Is the LA Times alleging that Jewish people protesting Israel's occupation of Palestine are terrorists? 2. Claim: Is it any wonder that in the fall that they have a "great deal" or "fair amount" of confidence in the media? Fact: I agree it is no wonder that Americans have such a low level of confidence in the media, especially when such media so readily publishes propaganda smearing a peaceful protestor as a terrorist, without a shred of evidence or facts. 3. Claim: By any metric, Khalil is a wildly unsympathetic figure. Fact: By every metric, this is false. In reality, Khalil is extremely popular, with the petition calling for his release . The LA Times purposefully hides Khalil's popularity, as admitting such facts counters their efforts to dehumanize him. 4. Claim: The New York Times described him as the "" at Columbia. Fact: It is laughable that the LA Times first slams legacy media as unreliable and untrusted by the American public, then immediately cites the NY Times to describe Khalil. Moreover, is protesting against injustices committed by a government now criminal? Isn't the celebration of free speech, even speech you disagree with, the whole point of being a democracy? Apparently, not all free speech critical of a government is free, according to the LA Times. 5. Claim: He acted as the lead negotiator for a pro-Hamas student group called Columbia University Apartheid Divest. Fact: Mahmoud Khalil has remained on record , and the US Government has provided zero evidence proving that claim against him. This is what due process of law is supposed to address--and what the Trump regime continues to deny him. (More on this below). No wonder Trump's claim that he's had the "most transparent administration ever " received a "" award. 6. Claim: Which has referred to Hamas ' Oct. 7, 2023, slaughter of Israelis as a "" and asserted that it is fighting for nothing less than "." Fact: You can read CUAD's own statement about themselves published in full in the . You'll note their simultaneous condemnation of Islamophobia and antisemitism, as "cut from the same cloth." Additionally, distasteful speech is still protected free speech. And yet additionally, the US Government has provided zero evidence that Khalil uttered those words, let alone endorsed them. All of that notwithstanding, I am glad the LA times condemns violence--I do too. So where is this energy from the LA Times when the Israeli government made violent statements about eradicating Gaza? "Fighting human animals." Making Gaza a "slaughterhouse." "Erasing the Gaza Strip from the face of the earth."" And where was this energy when Netanyahu acted on those violent statements with ? How are reactionary words from CUAD worse than Netanyahu's violence that mass murders tens of thousands of civilians? The LA Times never explains. 7. Claim: Even more relevant, Khalil is not a U.S. citizen. He is a green card holder, a "legal alien." And he can remain on our soil only when the sovereign -- in the U.S., that's "We the People" -- consents to it. When we remove our consent, that person can be deported. Fact: The LA Times assumes that "removing consent " is a whisk of a magical wand that allows kidnapping a person to an undisclosed location by plain clothes ~~Nazis~~ ICE agents without a judicial warrant. In reality, "removing consent " requires due process of law, as guaranteed by the 5th, 6th, and 14th Amendments to the United States Constitution. To ignore these obligations is a breathtaking level of corruption, and a blunt declaration that equal justice is no longer a principle of the Western civilization the LA Times piece professes to cherish. If you 're finding value in my analysis, join our movement and become a free or paid subscriber. 8. Claim: The power to exclude is a defining feature of what it means to be a sovereign. Emer de Vattel 's highly influential 1758 treatise, "The Law of Nations," described this power as plenary: "The sovereign may forbid the entrance of his territory either to foreigners in general, or in particular cases, or to certain persons, or for certain particular purposes, according as he may think it advantageous to the state." Fact: Why the LA Times is citing Prussian philosopher Emer de Vattel, who died in 1767, before the United States even existed, is beyond me. Obviously, his treatise is not the United States Constitution, not a federal law, and not even written by a Founding Father. In fact, it is wholly irrelevant to Khalil's case in every conceivable way. Yet, this is only one of two absurd arguments LA Times cites to justify denying Mahmoud Khalil due process of law--the second argument is somehow even worse. 9. Claim: As the late Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia noted, "Due process does not invest any alien with a right to enter the United States, nor confer on those admitted the right to remain against the national will." Fact: The LA Times laughably cites a Supreme Court dissent as evidence that Khalil is being justifiably disappeared. First of all, it is a dissent opinion, meaning the Supreme Court majority already ruled against the disappearing of a non-citizens. Moreover, the case cited, Zadvydas v. Davis, does not contemplate a legal and documented green card holder disappeared without due process. It contemplates when: An alien has been found to be unlawfully present in the United States, and A final order of removal has been entered, [and] the Government fails to remove the alien during those [statutorily required] 90 days. " None of these three conditions apply to Khalil. Khalil was not unlawfully in the United States. There has never been any order, let alone any final order, of removal entered against him by any court. There was no delay beyond some 90 days the government had to remove him. And even in his dissent, Justice Scalia writes that he "A criminal alien under final order of removal." So to recap, the LA Times cites a Prussian philosopher who died before the United States existed and a Supreme Court dissenting opinion that specifically applies to criminal aliens under judicially ordered removal--as evidence that it's legal, moral, and ethical to disappear and deport a documented green card holder without due process. Is this sheer anti-Arab bigotry or just utter incompetence? Perhaps both. 10. Claim: It 's quite simple, really: If someone in the U.S. on a tourist visa or in possession of a green card violates the terms of his admission, he can be removed. Fact: No, it's not "quite simple," really. Due process of law exists to make it painstakingly difficult for the US Government to deny us our rights. The Founders, flawed as they were, recognized the harm of tyrannical government, and established the Constitution and Bill of Rights to require the Government to prove beyond a reasonable doubt that a person actually committed a crime before they were deprived of their rights--and only after the judicial branch and a jury of the person's peers agree. People can only be removed but with due process of law , as the 5th, 6th and 14th Amendments to the US Constitution require. That due process is a detailed process that requires probable cause, a warrant signed and authorized by a judge, Miranda rights, access to legal counsel, a trial by jury, a conviction beyond a reasonable doubt, an opportunity to appeal, and an opportunity to appeal again to the Supreme Court. None of that has been afforded to Mahmoud Khalil. As a reminder, the 5th Amendment specifically states, "Noperson shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property, without due process of law." The word employed is "person," not "citizen." Unless the LA Times is alleging that Mahmoud Khalil is not a person--which may not be far from what they believe given their dehumanizing rhetoric against Palestinians and Arabs--then Khalil is privileged to 5th Amendment protections, period. Anything short of that undermines the American experiment altogether. That the LA Times continues to push for a denial of due process demonstrates the emptiness of their claim to "uphold Western civilization." 11. Claim: Khalil [is] a foreign national who allegedly violated the terms of his sojourn by supporting at least one U.S. State Department-designated foreign terrorist organization. Fact: Repeatedly claiming that Khalil "allegedly" violated the terms of his green card, without providing any evidence, and while denying due process, means you have elevated falsehood, not affirmed facts. People with integrity tend to happily provide evidence to back up their claims. People committed to propaganda ask readers to believe claims without evidence. The LA Times is sadly engaging in the latter. 12. Claim: And by making common cause with an organization clamoring more generally for the end of Western civilization. Fact: Again, Khalil denies he ever led CUAD, there's no evidence he did, and the US Government has failed to provide any such evidence. The LA Times is effectively announcing they want to punish protected free speech they don't like. 13. Claim: The day the United States loses the ability to deport noncitizens who espouse such toxic beliefs is the day the United States ceases to be a sovereign nation-state. Fact: On the contrary, alleging that US sovereignty rests upon the ability to violate the US Constitution and deport people the US Government doesn't like without due process is the day the United States ceases to be a functioning democratic republic. And as it seems the LA Times admits it supports such absurdity, perhaps the Fourth Estate truly has fallen. 14. Claim: The Khalil saga is where we see the intersection of the three toxic anti-Western ideologies. First, there is the "woke" angle. Fact: I would bet the author of the LA Times article cannot define woke, or only "define" it while espousing anti-Black bigotry. While conservatives are loath to define woke, sometimes they accidentally tell the truth. , asked what "woke" means, [Ron Desantis' General Counsel] Newman said "it would be the belief there are systemic injustices in American society and the need to address them." Imagine being offended at the idea of addressing systemic injustices? Oh the humanity. 15. Claim: Khalil represented CUAD, which espouses a neo-Marxist oppressor/oppressed dichotomy, and its view of Israel as an "" underlies Khalil's repugnant activism. Fact: Repeating that Khalil "represents CUAD" without evidence doesn't make your case any stronger, it makes your lie that much bigger. Also, the view that Israel is oppressing Palestinians with an illegal military occupation is not Khalil's mere opinion, it is established fact as held by the United Nations, Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, The International Court of Justice, hundreds of UN Resolutions, dozens of international NGOs, and by Israeli human rights organizations like . 16. Claim: Second, there is the Islamist angle: CUAD supports Sunni Islamist outfits such as Hamas. Fact: Color me surprised that the author of this LA Times piece is also an Islamophobe and historical revisionist. The facts demonstrate that Hamas is not a religious organization, nor is it a proactive organization. It is a violent political reaction to decades of illegal occupation, an occupation that many human rights orgs, 17. Claim: Third, there is the global neoliberal angle: Those protesting Khalil 's detention see little distinction between citizen and noncitizen. Fact: The so-called "little distinction between citizen and noncitizen" when it comes to rights under the US Constitution is from (checks notes) the United States Supreme Court. : " (1886) guaranteed due process rights not only to newly freed African Americans, but also legal immigrants such as Chinese immigrant Yick Wo. Justice Matthews opined: The Fourteenth Amendment to the Constitution is not confined to the protection of citizens.... These provisions are universal in their application to all persons within the territorial jurisdiction, without regard to any differences of race, of color, or of nationality, and the equal protection of the laws is a pledge of the protection of equal laws [Ref. 11, p 369]." "Shortly thereafter in (1896) the Court ruled that, although Wong Wing was an undocumented immigrant detained for unauthorized entry into the country, due process rights applied to him." And numerous subsequent Supreme Court cases repeatedly affirm due process rights to all people in this country--citizen or not, documented or not--up through and including the 2001 case the LA Times article cites. But yet, the LA Times wants us to believe that a documented green card holder can be disappeared because the US Government felt like it? Absurd. Simply absurd. 18. Claim: Khalil 's arrest and detention are thus only in part about Khalil. Fact: This injustice is about every single person in the United States. If the Constitutional guarantee of due process of law can be arbitrarily stripped for Mahmoud Khalil, then it can be stripped of every single person in this country regardless of their citizenship or documented status. That should horrify anyone who cares about a free democratic republic. 19. Claim: On Monday, posted, alongside a corresponding photo, "Free Mahmoud Khalil." But if those Senate Democrats and Khalil's myriad other apologists are being honest, they seek not merely to "free" Khalil from President Trump's Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency. Fact: Yes, beyond freeing Khalil from illegal ICE custody, we are trying to free our nation from a fascist regime that does not adhere to the United States Constitution or due process of law. In 2025 the US Government seeks to deport an Arab American green card holder without due process of law by claiming, without evidence, that he's a terrorist for Hamas. We've been here before, as much as the LA Times wants to pretend otherwise. Here are the receipts they refuse to acknowledge: In 1942 the US Government denied thousands of . Also in 1942 the US Government denied more than 100,000 . In 1927 the US Government enforced Virginia's Eugenical Sterilization Act, which forced sterilization of more than . In 1830 the US Government enforced the Indian Removal Act, ethnically cleansing Indigenous Americans from their lands , and the following year in 1831 passed legislation barring Indigenous people from suing when the US Government broke its treaties, once again denying due process of law. And this horrid list goes on. We've been here before. We cannot and will not go back. 20. Claim: Rather, they seek to free [Mahmoud Khalil] -- and all of us -- from the shackles of Western civilization itself. Fact: The only persons trying to "free" the United States from the "shackles of Western civilization" are those who want to undermine our US Constitution and justify disappearing a person without due process of law. In reality, the Constitution doesn't shackle the American people, or anyone in America--it shackles the Government from engaging in tyranny and oppression against any person within its jurisdiction. It protects all people within US jurisdiction from having their rights removed without due process of law. If we forsake this principle, we forsake American democracy altogether--as we've already seen happen with Japanese Americans, Jewish people, Black Americans, and Indigenous Americans, among many other minority communities throughout our history. And now, apparently, the LA Times wants to repeat that horror with Arab Americans. What a cowardly position the LA Times has published. Conclusion The LA Times' reckless publication of blatant propaganda is yet another reminder that corporate media is not here to inform--it is here to manipulate. When a newspaper with the reach and influence of the LA Times elevates fascist rhetoric, smears a man without evidence, and actively justifies the erosion of due process, it ceases to be journalism and becomes state-sponsored disinformation. It's one more reason to help push back against these destructive narratives. If we don't push back, this won't stop at Mahmoud Khalil. We have seen this before--as described above--and the pattern is clear: dehumanization, criminalization, and then, with the public sufficiently primed, outright genocide. That's how fascism takes hold. And this is why we cannot allow this disinformation to go unchallenged. Our Constitution guarantees due process of law for a reason. It exists to shield the vulnerable from government overreach and political persecution. If we let this slide because we think it does not affect us, we are signing off on our own silence when the next person--maybe someone we love--is labeled an "enemy" and stripped of their rights without evidence. We do not have to accept this and we are not powerless--at least not yet. We can hold these institutions accountable, demand facts over propaganda, and refuse to let disinformation dictate our democracy. The fight for justice is ongoing, but history shows us that when we organize, resist, and refuse to back down--we win. Let us make sure that, once again, we win, and save Western civilization by upholding justice and due process, not fear and hate. Before you go! Public officials are entrusted with their positions to serve the people, not to enrich themselves or any private entity. The use of government power for personal or financial gain undermines the core principles of fairness and justice that our democracy is built on. When I first ran for office, I committed to rooting out corruption at every level of government. Under the Trump administration, we've witnessed corruption become widespread and almost normalized. From officials using their positions for personal gain to companies receiving undue advantages from the government, we've seen how deeply corruption has infected Washington. This isn't just a series of isolated incidents, it's a pattern of behavior that puts corporate interests ahead of the American people. The actions we're seeing today are symptomatic of a much larger problem: a government that no longer works for the people, but for the super-rich and well-connected. We cannot allow these corrupt practices to continue unchecked. We must act. As your Senator, I will continue to push for the reforms that are necessary to clean up Washington, restore integrity to our institutions, and ensure that our government truly works for all of us. It's vital that we hold our leaders accountable, demand transparency, and insist on a government that serves everyone. body:
No matter how I'm treated by some colleagues, nothing diminishes my awe and gratitude at getting to represent Delaware in Congress.
Hi, it’s Congresswoman Sarah McBride.
I wanted to reach out and say thank you for all of the support I’ve received over the last few weeks.
No matter how I'm treated by some colleagues, nothing diminishes my awe and gratitude at getting to represent Delaware in Congress. It is truly the honor and privilege of a lifetime.
I simply want to serve and to try to make this world a better place — and I’m going to keep doing that no matter what some Republicans throw my way.

| | In the last few weeks, Donald Trump has unleashed and reversed and again unleashed and reversed a wave of reckless tariffs on Canadian goods, and here's what that means for you: higher prices and economic chaos. **Targeted tariffs are sometimes an important tool in our toolbox, but Trump's tariff tantrums are another self-serving move to distract from his plans to massively cut taxes for his billionaire friends while you're stuck paying the price.** And with Canada planning to retaliate with tariffs of their own, Trump's trade war will only intensify financial and global turmoil. People want their elected officials to deliver on policies that make their lives better. Folks are already struggling to afford rent, feed their families, and pay for health care. **Donald Trump's latest tariff shenanigans do nothing to alleviate the stress ordinary Americans are feeling.** **Trump's costly trade war will mean more economic pain for working families.** These higher costs are the difference between healthy meals, paying for daycare, getting to work with a full tank of gas, or affording rent. I was elected to the Senate to get things done for Oregonians, and I'm not backing down. I'm always focused on delivering real solutions that put people first. Lowering costs, investing in local communities, and pushing for climate action that protects our planet and our health are issues I'm working on every day, with you at the center of every fight. **Right now, I'm working with my colleagues to tackle the real issues head-on while exposing the devastating consequences of Trump's ego-driven trade wars. clean_body: Trump’s costly trade war will mean more economic pain for working families. | | | | In the last few weeks, Donald Trump has unleashed and reversed and again unleashed and reversed a wave of reckless tariffs on Canadian goods, and here's what that means for you: higher prices and economic chaos. Targeted tariffs are sometimes an important tool in our toolbox, but Trump's tariff tantrums are another self-serving move to distract from his plans to massively cut taxes for his billionaire friends while you're stuck paying the price. And with Canada planning to retaliate with tariffs of their own, Trump's trade war will only intensify financial and global turmoil. People want their elected officials to deliver on policies that make their lives better. Folks are already struggling to afford rent, feed their families, and pay for health care. Donald Trump's latest tariff shenanigans do nothing to alleviate the stress ordinary Americans are feeling. Trump's costly trade war will mean more economic pain for working families. These higher costs are the difference between healthy meals, paying for daycare, getting to work with a full tank of gas, or affording rent. I was elected to the Senate to get things done for Oregonians, and I'm not backing down. I'm always focused on delivering real solutions that put people first. Lowering costs, investing in local communities, and pushing for climate action that protects our planet and our health are issues I'm working on every day, with you at the center of every fight. Right now, I'm working with my colleagues to tackle the real issues head-on while exposing the devastating consequences of Trump's ego-driven trade wars. These costly policies aren't just headlines: they're hurting our farmers and ranchers, small businesses, and working families. I won't stand by while Trump gambles with our economy. Onward! name: PoliticsPA
subject: Flipping the Script on Crime
body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This new segment dives into what you need to know about arresting, prosecuting, and addressing crime in Pennsylvania.

PA Attorney General **Dave Sunday** shares insights that you don’t want to miss.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **PA Attorney General Dave Sunday** breaks down the systemic issue of retail theft explaining how organized criminal groups “use people who are addicted to drugs and people who are being trafficked” to steal and emphasizes the need to “arrest and prosecute the people making the money and driving the crime” to end the corruption. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a22e29a505&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Crime_
* Drug-related deaths statewide have **decreased** by approximately **33%** from their highest point in 2023. [[NPR](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=06e0d30a47&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* The SEPTA Transit Police Philadephia Department reported a **34% decrease** in serious crimes in 2024 compared to 2023. [[SEPTA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a31b577cb3&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Philadelphia's homicide rate in 2024 dropped to its lowest level in ten years, reflecting a**50% decrease** since 2021. [[NBCPhiladelphia](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=262e804e92&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* In 2024, the safest cities statewide were Hampden Township, Mount Lebanon, and Upper Allen Township with violent crime rates below**0.5**. [[Reolink](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ac3885ac8e&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Even in the safest cities in PA, there has been at least **one reported violent crime for every 1,000 residents.**[[Reolink](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=230ef92827&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Nationally the U.S. saw a **10.3% decrease** in serious crimes on the system in 2024 compared to 2023. [[FBI.GOV](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=47916d565a&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **PA Attorney General Dave Sunday on Addressing Crime & Corruption**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=fba0acbf1a&e=b7b3eddce2 "PA Attorney General Candidates on Economy, Healthcare, Crime, and More – Keystone Candidate Forum")
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2e3b5e81af&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=97f18741b5&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b923887f82&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=11fc292b23&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b7ffb0ac68&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.
Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0b60a9dd04&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

[](http://links.redconservatives.com/s/c/TLN7g9ISfst_AhuMjnnantXMyWvDhAVObUngKk1ya3qDOBV5nJkhjxTA8PZdVFCY38To0SyiXS4XUL8PgIsJDqtR6aq7gxMijKZjjNkGrCFiQwoQGHIyYRD7vSRCOvoBQCc6dsgh2eIhYjGjvHLi8VgsoKveviVeZKLOEdhT8fpp29riH2ttol5pUILQy8jjly2b567Gu17GwQD6nGcbplnYtn0YeSyIXtkWVrYG-DhLNjthIXgreQjHGiC7ZaqszkDBEYylubxrXOa3PVTXpJIHGpeACMye-nv_NngfdPeEW5dEpKpU-munWXj_moe2f5TjYfSi-04c-x4z6Hq2QnlfL3jsOrZLTCGQPp-_WlvzYCKTSBiAou1J8jGdqbuqS4e__FfF1YGDEJ6zcNhLcB9JNNcHLsztb4RH-qF-KijGE5wAhBQqJHq6E3FTg-_S8FQzOHKwGMwUKQ/Y3iXzomb1gCttnZ6ZqFYoWId-imBr8LB/7)

But after you watch this video, you'll learn...
* Why the American Founders created the Electoral College and how the two-party system changes the way it functions

* How the Electoral College prevents political campaigns from focusing only on urban--and not rural--voters; and

* What presidential elections would look like without the Electoral College and how the national popular vote could lead to a _decrease_ in election integrity.

As you can see, this free twelve-minute video taught by Hillsdale College politics professor Kevin Portteus is packed with critical information so many Americans don't know--even patriotic Americans who love this country.

They may understand that the Electoral College is important but can't explain why.

**It 's not their fault. **

Too many schools nationwide have abandoned teaching about these important constitutional principles in favor of critical race theory, transgender ideology, or whatever Marxist ideology they dress up in some new "woke" lingo.

**But it 's _never_ too late to learn. **

After watching "The Electoral College Explained," one viewer commented on YouTube, _" This makes so much more sense now. Thanks!"_

**Here 's a link to watch the video.**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-video**](http://links.redconservatives.com/s/c/oTXbJDmiw-YtlNh7YFbKovV5IzQc7ldv1ItFCYC1oTS3qDWueu-oPaIRdOxCaxHwqGI-zcmkM5CvnL8J7wkJ2HXB0a6h1pUWPrx8bHBB7Lrxtl8VOw3_V9zikAN3MJB5hVaXQHDvVWYkRVvI4ClFM-moQDWEvuHkj3SXTCxBaqAOzyjZmizjYVzpU-9TvELxE0K-l0I-2sT0ZZ83_pKxPymPirHA0x5RFYhIf10rC1828ku0JrCBMeb85hKY2WADjbR4l8YfjY19MxiSWA6qFPafJPY4DBoqU4PBnzsjy2bXN_hucsuJ4uX7M6Li5-_isLKQWV4UYMXeoSc8TTamI29tzTjCiFeC0FYjq-6sDrcyP7K1gzXWJAfoABT5mSFX4QA3xh-jSipwgE-YixANJIhwFXneq5YvFt1-h5TfDX4L-hG8cUa2ghusUJ6L7kTWIsBXe024SymcjQ/ZQm6p0SPjNSaUbsCvupEQ_p0m-Ps5Ak5/7)

When you watch, you're guaranteed to understand everything we stand to lose if we replace the Electoral College with a national popular vote.

And when the far-Left works to keep Americans ignorant of our institutions--and why they are important--your willingness to learn is one ESSENTIAL way you'll fight for our country on the battlefield of education.

Thank you.

Warm regards,

Labin Duke, Th.M.

| | | ATTN: All Grassroots Conservatives
From: Majority Leader Steve Scalise
RE: The State of our Pro-Trump House Majority
* * *

Our MAGA Trifecta is under siege.

The Democrat Machine is readying their battle plans to retake the House Majority.

So I'm taking it upon myself to sound the alarm and rally Conservatives from every corner of our country to save our Conservative House Majority once and for all.

**The current state of play:**

>>> There are THREE upcoming Special Elections - and we need to win all of them. As of right now, the size and strength of our House Majority FULLY DEPEND on the Special Elections in _FL-01, FL-06, and NY-21._

>>> The top House Democrat Super PAC just announced they're spending MILLIONS to overwhelm Conservatives in _23 competitive districts_ with false and dishonest attack ads.

>>> Democrats are outraising and outspending us earlier than ever before. They have announced a _$50 million slush fund_ to attack Conservatives across the board. We don't have that kind of money right now.

**The Stakes:**

House Democrats are inching their way toward destroying our MAGA Trifecta.

Dear Friend,
---
We’re kicking off June in Boston — the birthplace of the First Great Awakening. It’s a special place, woven into the fabric of our nation and our faith. But Boston has strayed from seeking God, and has instead indulged in rebellion and moral decay. June has been hijacked by the enemy as Pride Month, but I’m calling on believers to reclaim it. Starting June 1st in Boston, I’m proclaiming it **LIFE MONTH**! Our revival on the Boston Common will be a very special time of praise, worship, and celebration — honoring how God has used the city of Boston to advance His Kingdom, and calling on Him to pour out a fresh anointing on the city!
---
| | [](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=293e41200073425686bd34c6683252d2&_e=g2m6LSTEhXJqeICuGzfdeoZg4J6WsRfzEi3sDYb-S4SJF8Nsx8JPhUK5vNP26ZnLc3maskxjmGM_MfD2eqga8jSBVe-jiF72gbC7Bcs1ekJ-GXbDYyePz7N-wghunRr6d4-z2qnwvGzs3GfhO75956wLRlmuc_sT5gvBOb9JKTJzre6-godpJPM89P1CyTcIokr-G7pNgBf4Bi70lA53FzNWZdn3uTSV_iN-kZ_EJNsS9_0jAYFnNFCH9uri5496HiLEZU7kwcVdoxhRvFzAYVHRfSJ5FWR_ii8J1HNKe71lfwB7un6rXcYCOmMNERXd)
---
| | And we want **you** to be a part of it — through your presence, your prayers, or your provision. First and foremost, we want you **there** worshiping with us! If you can’t join us in person, please join us in spirit — covering the event in prayer and supplication. And finally, if you feel led, consider helping provide for the costs of putting on this free revival. Just like the presence of God, there’s never a cover charge at a _Let Us Worship_ event — and that’s all thanks to the generosity of believers from across the nation.
---

Sean

Hi friend,
An unelected, billionaire bureaucrat is dismantling our government. They claim they are seeking "government efficiency," but as I said earlier this month, their only agenda is looking out for themselves.
The latest target for DOGE and Elon Musk is the Department of Education, which they plan to shutter in the coming days and weeks. You read that right. They are trying to eliminate the department tasked with, among many other things, administering aid for our public schools, funding for students with disabilities, and things like Pell Grants for college students in need.
They're also gambling with Medicaid, defunding police, and risking cancer research. That's why I voted against the extremist, misguided government funding measure earlier this month.
I ran for Congress to lower costs and get things done for New Jersey families. That's who I'm fighting for. But Mike Johnson and House Republicans are coming after me, poised to spend millions to buy NJ-09 and flip it red. We cannot let them.

body:
The Democrat Machine is readying their battle plans to retake the House Majority.

| | | ATTN: All Grassroots Conservatives
From: Majority Leader Steve Scalise
RE: The State of our Pro-Trump House Majority
* * *

Our MAGA Trifecta is under siege.

The Democrat Machine is readying their battle plans to retake the House Majority.

So I'm taking it upon myself to sound the alarm and rally Conservatives from every corner of our country to save our Conservative House Majority once and for all.

**The current state of play:**

>>> There are THREE upcoming Special Elections - and we need to win all of them. As of right now, the size and strength of our House Majority FULLY DEPEND on the Special Elections in _FL-01, FL-06, and NY-21._

>>> The top House Democrat Super PAC just announced they're spending MILLIONS to overwhelm Conservatives in _23 competitive districts_ with false and dishonest attack ads.

>>> Democrats are outraising and outspending us earlier than ever before. They have announced a _$50 million slush fund_ to attack Conservatives across the board. We don't have that kind of money right now.

**The Stakes:**

House Democrats are inching their way toward destroying our MAGA Trifecta.

If we fail to win the fundraising race and LOSE these Special Elections, our razor-thin firewall could CRUMBLE - allowing Radical Democrats to jam up, block, and stonewall anything they want.

_The fate of President Trump 's entire legislative agenda depends on us._
| | [CHIP IN NOW](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjs1mujh499ftj5ef745fejbah7n2c5hnfh3023g_ "CHIP IN NOW")
---

**The Plan:**

The FIRST quarterly deadline since President Trump took office is just days away and we're dangerously behind our goal.

**So I 'm launching an all-out fundraising blitz to rally between 10,000 and 20,000 grassroots Conservatives by the end of the month to help keep our House Majority iron-clad.**

_**[Could you spare a few bucks to help us continue on our quest to Save America?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6vdg417f813vv59raoo74cijrkakeov8phker10_ "Could you spare a few bucks to help us continue on our quest to Save America?")**_
| [CHIP IN NOW](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf69122h06bkotmpvvb55qjpac9h4hcopvfrshb0_ "CHIP IN NOW")
---

Failure _IS NOT_ an option.

Anything you can give - no matter how much - moves mountains in our fight to save the House.

Thank you for everything you do for me, President Trump, and the country.

To victory,

Steve Scalise

**June 5, 2018.**
Do you remember it? I'll never forget it — that was the day we launched our first campaign for Congress.
The truth is, I had no idea what to expect.
I knew we had a large number of supporters who would be willing to commit the time and hard work needed to run a campaign of that magnitude, but I also knew that one of the biggest challenges we'd face would be funding a winning campaign.
But because of supporters like you, that was never in doubt. We were able to organize and mobilize our movement in Minnesota's 5th district, fighting off unprecedented right-wing attacks and outside spending along the way.
Two years later in 2020 we did it again. And again in 2022 and 2024.
**Midnight, March 31st.**
A little over a week from now — our first FEC fundraising deadline of 2025 and our first with Trump back in the White House.
I know my team and I have reached out about deadlines like this before, but it’s really important that we have a big show of momentum this month.
People are wondering if progressives are up to the task of standing against Trump, Elon Musk, and their far-right agenda, meaning if we fall short we’ll send all the wrong messages about the strength of this movement.
**$3.**
That's the amount I'm asking you to contribute right now to stand with our movement, close our fundraising gap, and get the job done.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

** | Beth is a single, working mother of two amazing kids. Every day, she reminds them that we live in the greatest state, in the greatest nation, in the history of the world.

clean_body: Would you support an investigation into how the Army has been spending its food allowance budget intended for enlisted soldiers? | Fellow American, I think one thing every American can agree on is that our troops shouldn’t go hungry; that I’m even writing this in an email to you is distressing to me personally. As a member of the House, I’ve spoken at length with men and women who wear our nation's uniform and want nothing but the best for them; we owe them everything. The very least we can do for them is ensure that the funds the military takes from their paychecks to pay for their food are used for their intended purpose. Fellow American, the previous presidential administration stonewalled anyone who dared investigate how they appropriated Congressionally Approved funds. Now that Republicans hold a trifecta in Washington—the White House, the Senate, and the House— we can finally get to the bottom of issues like this, which I find unbelievably reckless. I appreciate your time, Beth Van Duyne Member of Congress, TX-24 GET TO KNOW BETH: | Beth is a single, working mother of two amazing kids. Every day, she reminds them that we live in the greatest state, in the greatest nation, in the history of the world. Where else but the United States could a girl leave home at the age of 17, put herself through college, become the first female Mayor of her hometown, and then be asked to serve America in a presidential administration? Beth Van Duyne is running for Congress because she knows the people of the 24th District deserve to have a strong, principled voice in Congress. She's been asked what prompted her to run for public office; the answer is simple – her children. We live in a very fragile time for our nation, our families, and the future of the American Dream. Socialism is on the rise, our border crisis has never been worse, and we face constant threats from hostile nations willing to use cyber-attacks, nuclear weapons, and terrorist jihad. When Beth thinks about her two children, she wants them to have the same opportunities in life that she did; She wants them to be able to grow up safe and proud of our country. Beth is a single mom, a conservative Republican, a reformer who has defeated government corruption, a believer in the rule of law who has helped remove thousands of criminal aliens from North Texas, a leader who helped deliver growth and new job opportunities, and a Constitutionalist who has never backed down when it comes to protecting the rights of all North Texans. | PAID FOR BY BETH VAN DUYNE FOR CONGRESS _

clean_body: They had a choice—stand with female athletes or cave to the woke mob. In 2026, we’ll make them pay. | Fellow Patriot - I'm furious, and I know you are too. EVERY. SINGLE. SENATE. DEMOCRAT. had a choice: stand up for female athletes or cave to the radical left. They chose to abandon women. This includes vulnerable far-left Senator Jon Ossoff who has a daughter. Yet when given the chance to protect girls' and women's sports, he voted to let men take over. The fact is, Democrats care more about a woke agenda than fairness, safety and opportunity for female athletes. As a former NCAA swimmer, I know firsthand what it feels like to have the sport I love stolen by men who were allowed to compete against women. It's unfair, it's dangerous and it must stop. The Senate is red. Republicans fought for this bill. But without a filibuster -proof majority, the radical Left still has the power to kill commonsense legislation like this. That's why I'm fighting to unseat EVERY Democrat who voted against protecting women's sports. I can't do this alone. The Democrats have made their choice. Now, it's our turn. Let's fight back. #

Friend,
In just a moment, we’re going to ask you to join Mark Kelly and add your name to support our teachers and students.
Please, let us explain why this is so important.
**President Trump signed an Executive Order to dismantle the Department of Education. Elon Musk and DOGE are champing at the bit to get to work.**

As they proceed, they’ll wipe out nearly 10% of every K-12 school’s budget — funding that goes towards teacher salaries and training, support for low-income school districts, and protections for every student's civil rights. President Trump is gutting the Department of Education to help cover the cost of the trillion-dollar tax cut he’s cooking up for tech billionaire buddies like Elon.

Peter,
President Trump just called me a “loser” while hosting a press conference in the Oval Office. I’ll admit, it made me laugh. But it’s also a sad reminder of who our President is.
**That’s what life is all about for this guy: Pretending to be a big shot. And the entire country is paying the price for his insecurity.**
Donald Trump doesn’t care who he hurts as long as he feels special. Everything he’s doing – dismantling the Department of Education, attacking people for who they are and who they love, and picking unnecessary trade wars that are raising costs for working families – is about one thing: his ego.
Well, I don’t give a damn if I hurt his feelings. There’s too much at stake right now. Public education, Social Security, and our fundamental rights, freedoms, and values are all on the line, and I’m not going to sit by quietly.

| | | ATTN: All Grassroots Conservatives
From: Majority Leader Steve Scalise
RE: The State of our Pro-Trump House Majority
* * *

Our MAGA Trifecta is under siege.

The Democrat Machine is readying their battle plans to retake the House Majority.

So I'm taking it upon myself to sound the alarm and rally Conservatives from every corner of our country to save our Conservative House Majority once and for all.

**The current state of play:**

>>> There are THREE upcoming Special Elections - and we need to win all of them. As of right now, the size and strength of our House Majority FULLY DEPEND on the Special Elections in _FL-01, FL-06, and NY-21._

>>> The top House Democrat Super PAC just announced they're spending MILLIONS to overwhelm Conservatives in _23 competitive districts_ with false and dishonest attack ads.

>>> Democrats are outraising and outspending us earlier than ever before. They have announced a _$50 million slush fund_ to attack Conservatives across the board. We don't have that kind of money right now.

**The Stakes:**

House Democrats are inching their way toward destroying our MAGA Trifecta.

If we fail to win the fundraising race and LOSE these Special Elections, our razor-thin firewall could CRUMBLE - allowing Radical Democrats to jam up, block, and stonewall anything they want.

_The fate of President Trump 's entire legislative agenda depends on us._

The FIRST quarterly deadline since President Trump took office is just days away and we're dangerously behind our goal.

**So I 'm launching an all-out fundraising blitz to rally between 10,000 and 20,000 grassroots Conservatives by the end of the month to help keep our House Majority iron-clad.**

_**[Could you spare a few bucks to help us continue on our quest to Save America?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z9afmknm3oo7f7shoj0c5smfh69je73lsmsn1g3o_ "Could you spare a few bucks to help us continue on our quest to Save America?")**_

Failure _IS NOT_ an option.

Anything you can give - no matter how much - moves mountains in our fight to save the House.

Thank you for everything you do for me, President Trump, and the country.

To victory,

Steve Scalise

Jason Crow For Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/logoJC%20(1).png]
Mikie Sherrill is serving in Congress with Jason Crow to defend democracy and deliver for the people. Now, she's on a mission to get things done for New Jersey as governor. We hope you’ll read her team's message below, and then split a donation between her and Jason’s campaigns.

Team — Mikie has faced tough elections. In 2018, she took on an entrenched Republican incumbent even though nobody thought she had a shot.

But this may be the toughest race yet.

And we need to be prepared for one major X-factor: Elon Musk.

In the 2024 elections, Elon Musk spent $290 MILLION to tip the scales in Donald Trump and the GOP’s favor. He even attempted to influence elections right here in New Jersey — his PAC spent over $1 million to buy a toss-up House seat for Republicans.

All of that spending clearly paid off — because now he’s been given unprecedented power to run the federal government and slash critical services for working families across New Jersey.

Even worse? He’s not stopping there.

Not even two months into Trump’s second term, Elon Musk has already launched a seven-figure ad buy in support of an extremist state Supreme Court candidate in Wisconsin.

And given that national Republicans see a huge opportunity to flip the New Jersey governor’s seat, it’s only a matter of time before he gets involved here, too.

New Jersey cannot afford a governor who is beholden to Elon Musk. Not now, not ever. Our best chance at ensuring that never happens is by electing a strong Democratic governor. And there’s nobody with a better record of WINNING in the face of those attacks than Mikie. It’s how she delivered the biggest red-to-blue swing in the country in 2018 and why she consistently overperforms the top of the ticket.

So please, split any amount between Mikie’s campaign and Jason Crow right now to help us elect Mikie and ensure she has what it takes to fight back against whatever attacks come her way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-sherrill]

Trump and Musk are now coming after the United States Postal Service. Reports just confirmed that Trump is planning to dissolve the USPS leadership and push for either direct control or privatization — gutting a Constitutionally authorized, self-sustaining agency that millions of Americans rely on every day.

Think about what that means: If Trump gets his way, your mail delivery — prescription medications, Social Security checks, ballots, and more — could be controlled by his lackeys or private corporations whose only concern is their bottom line.

Gerry isn’t letting this attack go unanswered. In its place, the Democrats are now proposing $500 million in **spending cuts**. It's too early to celebrate because the final bill hasn't been released or even debated on the floor, but one thing is for certain - PRESSURE WORKS!

**ILLINOIS** In Springfield, Illinois, the Democrat supermajority is going after parents by pushing a bill that would increase regulations on homeschool families. This is the #1 issue in the state right now for conservative voters who are being ignored by their Democrat representatives. So earlier this week the **Illinois Freedom Caucus** welcomed hundreds of homeschool families to show their opposition to the heavy-handed legislation.

## It's All About the E
I got into an interesting conversation at dinner this week and then the very same topic subsequently came up on the Morning Meeting the following morning.
It was about the E in DEI.
It's always been the E that's the problem. Diversity of thought and opinion is good. I like to hear different perspectives when I making a decision. What class should I take in college? What should we have for dinner? Where should we go on vacation?
Even for the simplest decisions we make we generally like different - diverse - opinions to shape out outcome. It doesn't mean we weigh them all equally but at least I know I like to hear a variety of ideas. For what its worth when I get asked what is something we don't know about President Trump I usually say that unlike what the media presents, Trump loves to - actually welcomes -- competing ideas and perspectives.
Inclusion is also generally a positive quality. That's what teamwork is all about. You want co-workers, teammates and friends to feel included in key decisions.
I don't think many people have a problem with those two ends of DEI.
E is the issue.
The E is DEI stands for equity. When I asked google for a definition this is what I got back: **Equality** : the state of being equal, especially in status, rights and opportunities.
Equal. Sounds nice right? Very fair -- I get what you get.
But that's not really fair when you think about it is it? It's also not what America promised.
The promise is O -- opportunity.
We should have opportunity not equity as a guaranteed outcome.

body:
More than a hat: How Bernie Lake’s fight for health became a political battleground
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Happy Friday and 2nd day of Spring!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** As Colorado’s budget crisis deepens, Democrats are [eyeing the Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights (TABOR) for repeal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Critics say this move would strip voters of control over government growth and spending limits.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** After surviving cancer and returning to the gym in her “Make America Healthy Again” hat, Bernie Lake was [verbally and physically attacked](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). CU regents are [probing funding threats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) tied to a student cannabis campaign. [Bernie Sanders and AOC](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are rallying today in Greeley and Denver. A new law taking effect March 31 will let undocumented immigrants [obtain Colorado IDs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Trump’s order to dismantle the Department of Education faces [legal pushback](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while ICE arrests [longtime fugitive activist](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Jeanette Vizguerra, drawing sharp reactions on both issues.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** John Fabbricatore slams [sanctuary policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Priscilla Rahn criticizes Newsom’s late stance on [men in women's sports](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and Joy Overbeck defends the DougCo school board’s record amid [union backlash](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, March 21, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[More than a hat: How Bernie Lake’s fight for health became a political battleground](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
After fighting a cancer battle, Bernie Lake reclaimed her life while sporting her Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) hat. After breast cancer surgery, she returned to the Durango Community Recreation Center for her first post-treatment workout, determined to rebuild her strength.
Lake had been wearing her MAHA hat since July. “After the first assassination attempt on Trump, I was outraged that our political differences had gotten to such a level,” Lake said. “People need to see different political views where they live. I don’t care if you like Trump or not—we should be able to coexist.”
Silent disapproval was common. “Not one person had said a word to my face before. Plenty of snickers, plenty of side-eyes, but never anything more,” she recalled.
Cleared by her doctor, she went for a gym workout after undergoing breast cancer surgery. “I wanted to clear my head,” she said. “You get into fight mode when you go through cancer. I was looking forward to a good, long workout—with restrictions, of course—but still, something to push me forward.
Instead she found herself exercising her First Amendment rights.

**[Democrats target TABOR as budget crisis exposes reckless spending](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado faces a $1.2 billion budget deficit, prompting Democrats to propose revisiting TABOR limits on government spending.
* Republicans argue the shortfall is due to reckless spending, not revenue issues, and strongly oppose any effort to weaken TABOR.
* Past attempts to alter TABOR have failed at the ballot box, but Democrats hint more reform efforts may be on the horizon.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[CU Board of Regents investigates funding threats over cannabis research campaign](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The CU Board of Regents launched an independent investigation into Regent Wanda James after she allegedly threatened to pull funding from the Colorado School of Public Health over its cannabis education campaign.
* James objected to the campaign's illustrations and later claimed she discussed cutting funds with Governor Polis’ team, raising concerns about abuse of power.
* Regents emphasized their duty to protect the university’s integrity and pledged transparency as the third-party review moves forward.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fabbricatore: Sanctuary policies are costing Colorado millions—here’s how](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former ICE official John Fabbricatore criticizes Colorado’s sanctuary policies for shielding criminal aliens and preventing local law enforcement from cooperating with federal immigration authorities.
* He reveals the state has lost out on millions in federal reimbursements through the SCAAP program, especially as Denver stopped applying for the funds after 2016.
* A new Trump administration policy now blocks sanctuary jurisdictions from accessing these funds, worsening Colorado’s budget crisis and spotlighting the cost of its progressive immigration stance.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Overbeck: DougCo school board Conservative leadership delivers results – academic gains and parent power](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JOY OVERBECK | COMMENTARY | MARCH 21** _As soon as they were elected in 2021, the four new Conservative Douglas County School District (DCSD) directors were faced with the major issues of the time: the Covid pandemic, and the twisted woke movement to reduce parents’ influence by infecting students with leftist political ideologies._
**[Bernie Sanders and AOC bring progressive agenda to Colorado on Friday](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | MARCH 20** _Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (AOC) are set to hold rallies in Denver and Greeley on March 21, 2025, as part of Sanders’ national “Fighting Oligarchy: Where We Go From Here” tour._
**[Rahn: Newsom’s about-face won’t fix the unfairness of men in women’s sports](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY PRISCILLA RAHN****| COMMENTARY | MARCH 20** _Recently, several notable Democrats, who supported biological men in women’s sports, are now all of a sudden seeing the light. One notable politician, California Governor Gavin Newsom, recently broke with his party by saying that transgender athletes playing in female sports is “deeply unfair.”_

Peter, Republican lawmakers in Washington D.C. promised not to cut health care benefits. Peter,

Donald Trump and Elon Musk are in Washington pushing reckless cuts to the Department of Education — cuts that would devastate our public schools.
