Today, I _woke up_ to **numerous interview requests** and already **published stories** about [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11094.1.e82c55171b7b17584252d2880cd4638c). Of course none of them highlighted any of the **positive impacts** our church has upon hundreds of families every week but rather how we occasionally host events and speakers and whether or not we are violating the **Johnson Amendment** (which we are NOT). [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11095.1.9c7c6728e4777ad132b410c4947ee6e5) has been BLESSED with so many great guest speakers from preachers to politicians to athletes and beyond. Including: [Perry Stone](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11096.1.c3f44589adf3b7f2a23042f72f08293d), **Tim Tebow** , [Donald Trump Jr](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11097.1.782b0553c3f4b74c03abbc989d90e4ed)., [Eric Trump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11098.1.4e37c4401f53069003e71cb631dd3ab5), [Lara Trump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11099.1.f71940ba0984dca4e20a9a4ed7318c8d), [Rabbi Jonathan Cahn](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11100.1.c8545859d56b6c8dec5cc51fe419d212), [Darryl Strawberry](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11101.1.c5a57340656f7a8ebda2452f8a792338), **General Michael Flynn** , [Riley Gaines](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11102.1.b77196ce26e4431c4ecfdadd0b49c33d), [Mayor Rudy Giuliani](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11103.1.4fdd5ff8881a8c3efc207f6f4d295c7d), [Roger Stone](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11104.1.74e3fb0381b79e4c6cd14c7dc2ce518f), **Rodney Howard-Browne** , [Kash Patel](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11105.1.2a13bdb0da2f1380a69674d2a1e4a1ae), [Erick Stakelbeck](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11106.1.29662930decd5a005cba59f350a433a8), **Robert Kiyosaki** and so many others... Because our church is _not afraid_ to engage in the **current issues** that our culture faces we receive **relentless attacks** and **smear campaigns**. However, let me say that **we are not a political church**. We are a **biblical church**. The issues such as **life** , **gender** , **marriage** and etc... are not political issues but biblical issues. Therefore, we address them head on. I actually consider it an honor for our church to be at the **tip of the spear** in the culture war that our nation is currently in. I want to thank all of those who support [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11107.1.cead981e8d1cd766d0d800601dbeba33) financially because it through your generous giving that we are able to do what we have done and are positioned to do even more in the near future. **I believe the attacks are indicators that we are over the target.** [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11108.1.146c8a2d16f0e54a2f4bbccd16727a24) will continue to stand for **justice + righteousness**. To our friends and [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=20133430.11109.1.ba77b5a5af9fb1956a741ac82e9cbde3) family members always remember that **not everything the media says about us is true**... Peter,

This is outrageous. Republicans in Congress are trying to dismantle the Department of Education calling it “ _wasteful_ ” and "_unnecessary_." But for kids across the district, this isn’t politics, **this is their future**.

For many students, their public school isn’t just a place to learn—it’s a lifeline. It’s where they get the one warm, healthy meal they can count on each day. It’s where they have access to special education services, school counselors, and the resources they need to succeed.

If Republicans get their way, federal funding for our schools will be cut and all our students need to thrive will be at risk. Students in rural and underserved communities will suffer the most. body:
I heard from nearly 2,000 constituents in two days — veterans, federal workers, active duty service members, young people, seniors, and community members from all walks of life. Over the last few days, we have heard from over 1,000 people in Port Angeles and Aberdeen.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104277071/534838695/2145945666?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.03.21_NationalNews_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzNhMTcwYy04MzA2LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oO3zAoyIb-8gu68fIyx6fCj6a2cxYb5AFqb3aJP76ts=&emci=49ee4bab-7f06-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=433a170c-8306-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=23483442) | **Peter, YOU made national news!** Over 500 people showed up to our town hall in Tacoma on a Friday night — and on a rainy Saturday morning, hundreds more came to our town hall in Bremerton. The theater filled up in minutes with a long line of people still waiting outside. **But instead of turning anyone away, we decided to host _[TWO town halls](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104277072/534838696/-913389646?hl=en&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.03.21_NationalNews_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzNhMTcwYy04MzA2LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oO3zAoyIb-8gu68fIyx6fCj6a2cxYb5AFqb3aJP76ts=&emci=49ee4bab-7f06-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=433a170c-8306-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=23483442)_ that day.** I wanted to make sure I heard from everyone who took time out of their day to be there. I heard from nearly 2,000 constituents in two days — veterans, federal workers, active duty service members, young people, seniors, and community members from all walks of life. Over the last few days, we have heard from over 1,000 people in Port Angeles and Aberdeen. My Democratic colleagues are seeing huge crowds at town halls across the country. Meanwhile, D.C. Republicans are telling lawmakers to [_**stop holding public events**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104277073/534838697/1476571543?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.03.21_NationalNews_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzNhMTcwYy04MzA2LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oO3zAoyIb-8gu68fIyx6fCj6a2cxYb5AFqb3aJP76ts=&emci=49ee4bab-7f06-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=433a170c-8306-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=23483442) due to the widespread anger over DOGE, the betrayal of Ukraine, the threats to Medicaid, and more. They refuse to stand up to Musk and Trump’s destruction, and they refuse to face the people they’re supposed to serve. It’s another reason I’m organizing to flip the handful of seats we need to take back the House. Peter, In less than two weeks, voters will choose the next Wisconsin Supreme Court justice. I’m proud to support Judge Susan Crawford. She’s a fair, impartial jurist who has dedicated her career to protecting the rights, freedoms, and safety of all citizens. And it was an honor to go back to Wisconsin and campaign for her earlier this week. I’m all-in on this election because of a basic truth: **the outcome will determine if Wisconsin continues to be a beacon of hope in our quest for a true democracy – or not.[So I’m asking if you can make a donation today to help elect candidates like Judge Crawford in the Badger State and across the country.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104280340/534848785/790884352?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_HolderWisconsin_email_20250321-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsin_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250321-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsin_&utm_campaign=HolderWisconsin&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ2NTI3OGMzLTg4MDYtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mGHao9NY8qICPoCHtatzoYf1HYIf6bb4zMncw7JfEhE=)** **Wisconsin’s recent history reminds us that no matter how bleak things may look, we can still make change. No matter how tightly some anti-democracy leaders try to cling to unearned power, the will of the people can still prevail — as long as the people have the will to fight. ** When we began, the challenges in the Badger State could have seemed insurmountable. Conservatives had held control of Wisconsin’s highest court for more than a decade. Republican Governor Scott Walker and his allies had egregiously gerrymandered the state legislature to create artificially large GOP majorities. And for years, Wisconsinites were forced to live under unpopular policies enacted by those Republican majorities, despite the fact that Democrats saw increasing — and sometimes majority — statewide support. To be blunt: Wisconsin was governed by illegitimate minority rule. But the people of the Badger State did not give up. They organized. They voted. They forged a new chapter for their state. And at the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we had their back. We helped elect Democrat Tony Evers as governor. And because we knew then, like we know now, that fair-minded state supreme courts are vital to defending democracy, we invested in flipping control of the court, year after year. I supported fair-minded Wisconsin Supreme Court candidates in 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2023, visiting the state ahead of each of those elections and helping to rally voters. That long game culminated in the election of Judge Janet Protasiewicz in 2023, which broke the conservative stranglehold on the court. **The election was a reminder that in order to protect democracy, we must do democracy.** With a new majority on the bench and Tony Evers serving as governor, the gerrymandered state legislative maps’ days were numbered. Under new, fair maps in 2024, Democrats broke the Republican supermajority in the state senate and flipped seats in the state assembly, creating a path to win majorities in 2026. It was a new chapter for democracy in Wisconsin. That brings us to today, Peter, and the task before us: Electing Judge Susan Crawford and Democracy Defenders across the country. **If the far-right candidate wins, Wisconsin would lose its hard-won, pro-democracy state supreme court majority. The state’s highest court would go back to its extreme past of rolling back rights rather than protecting them.** In contrast, winning this race would mean building on the pro-democracy momentum we’ve worked so hard to create since we founded the National Democratic Redistricting Committee. And it would continue a model of success that can be applied to some of the most appallingly gerrymandered states today like North Carolina, Texas, Florida, and Ohio. **Our movement has been fighting for fairness state by state, year by year — we are playing the righteous long game. [I hope you’ll support us with a gift today to power the work ahead.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104280341/534848786/790884352?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_HolderWisconsin_email_20250321-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsin_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250321-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsin_&utm_campaign=HolderWisconsin&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ2NTI3OGMzLTg4MDYtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mGHao9NY8qICPoCHtatzoYf1HYIf6bb4zMncw7JfEhE=)** Thank you,

subject: I’m alive because of science.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
I won’t sit by while they dismantle everything.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104280669/534849810/1328794144?refcode=ea.bc0cec8f-8906-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ms=ea.bc0cec8f-8906-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJjMGNlYzhmLTg5MDYtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=g7jGjeOBChWkr6_95de7bIlPxH8c0trWAQEuW1jTs7c=&emci=b30cec8f-8906-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=bc0cec8f-8906-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=4823105)
---
I know what it’s like to get the news. To sit in a doctor’s office, hear that awful “c-word” — cancer — and feel the ground shift beneath you. In 2022, I was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. I went through months of chemotherapy. But I was lucky. I had access to incredible doctors and effective treatments made possible by decades of medical research. I don’t take that for granted. Not for a second. This is why I can’t stay silent while Donald Trump and Elon Musk work to tear down the protections that keep people from getting sick in the first place. They’re attacking the very science that saved my life. This administration is trying to slash hundreds of millions of dollars in medical research funding at the National Institutes of Health. They’re letting conspiracy theorists like RFK Jr. dictate public health policy and even pressuring scientists to erase references to mRNA vaccine technology from their research grant applications. These are direct attacks on life-saving science. And while this administration guts medicine, they’re also allowing corporate polluters to poison the air we breathe and the water we drink. **Trump’s EPA just unleashed the most consequential environmental rollback in decades** with plans to gut pollution limits on coal plants, clean car standards, and climate regulations. The EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said his goal, in his own words, is to drive **_“a dagger through the heart of climate-change religion.”_** If they succeed, Big Oil and corporate polluters will get a free pass to pump even more toxins into our environment, and the price we pay is measured in asthma attacks, cancer diagnoses, and lives cut short. This is why I’m staying in the fight. I know you’re tired, and it feels like hope is in short supply. I’m fighting those feelings, too — but despair is not an option. Cancer made me think even more about the time I have left and how I want to use it. **I don’t want to look back with regrets. I want to know that I did everything in my power to fight for the future — for our health and for the generations that come after us. That’s what keeps me moving forward. That’s why I refuse to sit this one out.** We owe it to our children and their children to demand better. We owe it to ourselves to end fossil fuel dependence and prioritize public health. At JanePAC, we’re building the strongest possible defense — electing bold down-ballot leaders who believe in science and will fight like hell to protect our health and our planet. **[We’re building grassroots power in states around the country to stop Donald Trump and his allies from pushing this reckless, deadly agenda at the state and local levels. But we can’t do it without your help. clean_body: I won’t sit by while they dismantle everything. | I know what it’s like to get the news. To sit in a doctor’s office, hear that awful “c-word” — cancer — and feel the ground shift beneath you. In 2022, I was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. I went through months of chemotherapy. But I was lucky. I had access to incredible doctors and effective treatments made possible by decades of medical research. I don’t take that for granted. Not for a second. This is why I can’t stay silent while Donald Trump and Elon Musk work to tear down the protections that keep people from getting sick in the first place. They’re attacking the very science that saved my life. This administration is trying to slash hundreds of millions of dollars in medical research funding at the National Institutes of Health. They’re letting conspiracy theorists like RFK Jr. dictate public health policy and even pressuring scientists to erase references to mRNA vaccine technology from their research grant applications. These are direct attacks on life-saving science. And while this administration guts medicine, they’re also allowing corporate polluters to poison the air we breathe and the water we drink. Trump’s EPA just unleashed the most consequential environmental rollback in decades with plans to gut pollution limits on coal plants, clean car standards, and climate regulations. The EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said his goal, in his own words, is to drive “a dagger through the heart of climate-change religion.” If they succeed, Big Oil and corporate polluters will get a free pass to pump even more toxins into our environment, and the price we pay is measured in asthma attacks, cancer diagnoses, and lives cut short. This is why I’m staying in the fight. I know you’re tired, and it feels like hope is in short supply. I’m fighting those feelings, too — but despair is not an option. Cancer made me think even more about the time I have left and how I want to use it. I don’t want to look back with regrets. I want to know that I did everything in my power to fight for the future — for our health and for the generations that come after us. That’s what keeps me moving forward. That’s why I refuse to sit this one out. We owe it to our children and their children to demand better. We owe it to ourselves to end fossil fuel dependence and prioritize public health. Elon Musk 's life right now is much like a Tesla--the wheels have come bouncing off, the steering wheel detached mid-turn and the recall notice was tweeted out by a Nazi who's committed two armed robberies since Trump pardoned him for January 6th. The man once hailed as a real-life Tony Stark is now more like a Bluetooth Roomba with a God complex. He's going in circles, crashing into walls, demanding the walls apologize for disrespecting his expertise on the mating habits of an African swallow. Meanwhile, Tesla stock's circling the drain--down over 50% since mid-December at today's open and boycotted the world over--his cybertrucks are being recalled--ALL--& his top Tesla investor just publicly told him to step down as CEO lest he continue to light the company on fire with the late-stage Howard Hughes + Pol Pot performance art. | | ---|---|--- And then there 's the dirty little secret nobody wants to talk about: He's so over-leveraged, w/ his idiotic purchase of that Nazi megaphone--Twitter. I can’t do this alone – I need committed supporters like you to step up and be part of our team. Here’s how you can make a difference:
1. Subscribe to My YouTube Channel
I’ll be livestreaming every week on my YouTube channel to connect with you, discuss important issues, and keep you updated on the campaign trail. 2. Volunteer & Host Events
Whether it’s helping at events, hosting gatherings, or just lending a hand where it's needed most, your support means the world. We need boots on the ground to make sure our voices are heard. If you’re willing to volunteer scroll down to the "Get in Touch" section of this letter and hit the "I'll Volunteer" button to tell us what you would like to do!

The clock is ticking, and every effort counts. To defeat Richard Ojeda and secure a victory for our district, we need to show up in full force. I believe in the power of our community, and together, we can make real change. Thank you for your continued support. Let’s take this fight to the next level and ensure a bright future for District 9! Warm regards,
Nigel Bristow

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104281252/534851750/-1295403277?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250321_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOWNlYjI0YS04YjA2LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_tepvcRXf8fvV5Z0Wr3Lx8WBz4y3jPvXnOLZCV-m6LI=&emci=91fb3de2-3a04-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=e9ceb24a-8b06-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=15529135) | We wanted to make sure you saw this: House Republicans passed a budget resolution that directs the House Agriculture Committee to cut programs in their jurisdiction by at least $230 billion. Experts say that many of those cuts are expected to come largely or _entirely_ from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). This is irresponsible and wrong. Millions of Americans rely on SNAP benefits in order to put healthy food on the tables for their families. **This move would put over 40 million Americans at risk for increased food insecurity, cut over $20 billion in income from farmers and ranchers, and have significant negative impacts on every part of the food supply chain.** SNAP is our most effective anti-poverty tool and is a vital safety net for families across the country. Instead, Republicans want to scrap the program altogether to help pay for tax cuts for the wealthiest business owners. **Jahana is refusing to stay silent.** She knows that cutting SNAP would be devastating, especially for rural communities and small towns, which is why she is working tirelessly to speak out and protect this vital program from being defunded. **[Jahana will fight to protect every dollar for critical programs like SNAP, but she cannot do it alone. Jahana and House Democrats are working to take back the House majority. * **In Arizona’s 6th** , Abe Hamadeh has stayed silent on the GOP’s attacks on birthright citizenship, which would likely impact him as the son of immigrants.

## Brave 3-Year-Old Saves Great-Grandmother
Three-year-old Bridger Peabody is [being hailed as a hero](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDGO6yAURVeDOyx4YDAFxW_c5bdTWi_wcBhhE2EUK7sfZRYw7b3S0dH5uq03zCUf23_cyactrT3VFQRMXCgOco2Yy3vVQ_SJCEgN5KXVMM1WzfPw8EmbO6QkgcgGg7Mwk6I5uGQECmfDkP2HJhRI6SYL02iEc5OerUGQ4j45pgXF3Gsbv2s--oNSedcXtTHUfSj-0fvzZOofg4XBcl3X6A66zs_LYMHWcyjEYPmMDJZSAxYGi-JvwsZrifzEF518a4Sdbw2PuCODxSqerJZOEvLZqMB1so6jCJbre0hgZNJEcWg-Pq9cSj6NZVpsO-byq9b_yvXy8BMAAP__2-tq6Q) after overcoming his fear of the dark to save his great-grandmother's life in Strasburg, CO. When Sharon Lewis fell and hit her head, she couldn't reach her phone--but Bridger, despite being scared, bravely ventured outside to retrieve it from a parked car. [Video footage](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z71ugzAUxfGnsTeQff2FBw-pKjqlW9URGbgGtyaOiAPi7Sv6AFnPkX7S__vaXX1M8TZ9-gVdmEJXQu6AgaqYqIB3o4_p6CQdXUAEFBQdNxJUY0TT0Nlp1IYJNniLQlodDFqOzHDR6z4ElDS6U2MCOLfKgKo1s1bJxmgPnPXKEslwjCWv9U-OtzJjSEfecK2HvNDk5lLuDyIuBFoC7b7v9ZGf5dnj-Z-LL8NMRLsR8T5_NfBxGdlb9UtXN973mFJ8aEMkmxYf0z9ZXmVuDv4CAAD__6TRVAw) captured him whispering, _"Don 't be afraid,"_ to himself as he pushed through his fear to complete the mission. Moments later, he proudly shouted, _"I got it, GG!"_ allowing Sharon to call for an ambulance. Though she suffered a concussion, she is now recovering, grateful for her quick-thinking great-grandson--who insists he's still not [a big kid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDFu7CAUAE-DOyx4BhsKit-429-mtMDvYZPgZcUSW3v7aHOA1CPNSPNxW24-5XTf_vuDXNzi0mJZQIDmYuAgF_QpvxbVoYtEQENHTk4KtJkGY7rdGZCR0IyAQa4YvAYUAa2agtYqCNsl97aJAaS0egLdj8Jarcw0epAiaMuUIEyt1P6zpHvbKeZXOan2azm67PbWHk82_GMwM5iv6-qvsx1yeGMGs68trZkYzGvJpXosvBXETJWjr198p1p4pef6TXyr_o6HZzCPSo5GWeiqw8eVck7PcWJKbIdP-Tfc_ppxOvgJAAD__wj1YjM) just yet.
## Couple Breaks Record for Longest Marriage
A Brazilian couple, Manoel Angelim Dino, 105, and Maria de Sousa Dino, 101, have set [a new Guinness World Record](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL1uxCAQhJ_G7rBgMf4pKNJcd2lTWmAWbiNsTsDZurePHKVO-81oRvq-7svdUKQ9fJoNtQ9-qT4twEExLhmIxRmK76VvnfaIgLJFLcYe1DTKaWof2lq7guRuUBz5II33Vs3CCOtXNU3etqSvNS5BiFmNoLqBz7Pqp3EwILhVc9NzdFRT7r4T7fWBPr7Tgblb09ZG_aj1WRr50cCtgdt5nl140b5jKWfK0WVcU3blKl_xhdgfa-A2KCFmFtMesFS2mZzJBGSRDtoDW9PrGbHN2j1PipHKMDY9D5uh-Hte_xNyaPgJAAD__7OWZjk) for the longest marriage of a living couple. Their [love story began](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kb2OnDAQgJ_GdLPyDyymoFgl2u5SRUqJBhjwXIyNbO9eSJFnj47tr_o-za808-tteEP2HNYfuFG_rMtQljhoqRuQBrQaZmR_DHU19wuRJlNRr9paN7Y11laub40cu5GkpM5YnLvaKjJTPSpEpCtOFfef06TRSnVNq5vLVXZdU9v2ilrJselELWnmEtPlPXIojhZ_xCelyxS3yveulD0LcxP6LvR9p7h7-kwJfR8T_mXPGGCKj90TfLgI749cYEzxN0GiKaYZlpjAx7BSLuD5yWGFDVNiXAk4gONcYjogO0yUIdOUqECJ4HDfD3gEjgGUutpGWiW0Eeb2T5hboT9FmO8_HQndaPnadarDfHIkCqdMMSycNpqF_mbrM3QQplcVhldX256Y8chV6uf9g73nfG1FLdcN2Z_nKF-96Nnr_wEAAP__6r-S8w) in Brazil in 1936, but it wasn't until 1940 that they reunited and fell in love. For the past 84 years and 85 days, their bond has remained strong, growing into a family that now includes 13 children, 55 grandchildren, 60 great-grandchildren, and 14 great-great-grandchildren. When asked about their secret, Maria [simply said](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLFyhCAUAL8GOxx84IEFRRq7S5vSQXngS1BukGju7zOXD0i9M7sz-3Gf7o4S7fHdbWhDDFMNeQIBPReSQzd5R-k5qcbbgAgoG7SdVtAbLY1pVqv04OYF_dABeGeUVEYsQZtZQZALYEP2ZRMSum7oNfTtTQxDr4y-OejE3A9MCfRUc2k_M-11xZCe-cTSLnlrkl1rfRxMvjEYGYzXdbUh_-x4HS_OYFzRpboyGJf8_UjI54Lu6-AFl1w8T3mPeFSe6KQ98s2VQi5iU6x_XJQSHTfNlIibo_QXrP9NOC38BgAA__9tLWGL), "Love. And that's something even the most advanced computer could never calculate."
## Earth's Tiniest Wildcat Captured on Camera
For the first time, the elusive rusty-spotted cat--[the world's smallest and lightest feline](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDFuhDAQAF8D3SJjbAyFizR0lzYl8uE1bGIwsvcO3e-jywPygBmN5us23xxFOtZPt6MNa5g5pFkKqUF0INvZO4qvWdXeBkSJXY22NUrqwXTDUG9WIaq7WhajtVnuPZoxCN2HflSqVdrrmuzbJjrZtqM2Uje9GEetBtM72Yq7Hisl0BOn3HwnOnjDEF_piblZ0l5HuzGfpeo-KjlVcrquq1lT8gde5UC-Uv5pUl4rOaHLvBVgOggLw0XRL46BCizu5EdGD-mAxe2YHYSUIVAuDEw7Am8I-VH4BeVMzOjhjaYAdHhylZzqbP15UYxUelMpse6O4l8g_zftaeVvAAAA____5nNR)--has been caught on camera in the forests of West Bengal, India. Weighing just 2 to 3.5 pounds and measuring 14 to 19 inches from head to tail, this tiny wildcat is rarely seen in the wild. This [elusive nocturnal predator](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80LGOhCAYBOCn0Q4DPyBaUFxjt9deaVj4US4IG2A1-_aX3Qe4_stkZn5u682EGNL2bQ7UfvNr83kFCpJQToCtzoT4WkXvtEcE5D1qpgTISfFp6nctmEPOrRCW85mNI-NUUecUTF6O1Mk-6Hca5cDYLBXIYaTzLMWkRgOM3uXcCYoutFyG3xxS29HHVz6xDDYffdR7a4_a8a8Olg6We9isaQWrfeKQy9bBYnOqWE7TQk4k4VU7WNqOpIX0Io_dpJYPkj25sDZyx7SZSJ7pxM9s8pZXLtFVUg8T4xtdITpiTeuLdo8rxBjqqDpBt8OE-KnV_rvq1PAXAAD__6EWbzg) thrives in dense forests but faces threats such as habitat loss, poaching, and human-wildlife conflict. Derek, When I took on the role of chair of the Democratic Party of Virginia, I did so with a deep love for this Commonwealth and an unshakeable belief in the power of people coming together to build a better future. Now, as I prepare to step away from this role, I find myself reflecting on all that we have fought for, all we have accomplished, and all the work that still lies ahead. Virginia Democrats have never backed down from a challenge. We have defended our rights, expanding opportunities, and stood against extremism every time it rears its head. | | _**Protecting Students and Empowering Parents**_
---
Friends, This week has been yet another incredible week for conservative Hoosiers and Americans across the county, with big changes coming both at home and in D.C. The week began with Governor Braun signing an executive order addressing the rising tide of antisemitism on our campuses. Governor Braun has made clear that Indiana will not tolerate antisemitic discrimination or intimidation within our state institutions or anywhere else. To close the week, Governor Braun attended the historic signing of President Trump's executive officially moving to disband the Department of Education. Governor Braun expressed his enthusiasm for the long-awaited order, emphasizing that Hoosier parents, not Washington bureaucrats, should have the power to determine the best educational path for their children. At the Indiana GOP HQ, we are proud to stand alongside President Trump, Governor Braun, and the rest of our conservative leaders as they work tirelessly to deliver freedom and prosperity for all Americans, and this week has once again highlighted their strength and resolve. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with.
---
| |
---
| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman

| | _**Governor Braun Signs Executive Order to Review Higher Education Antisemitism Response and Policies **_
---
---
**Governor Mike Braun** last Friday, signed an executive order to review the policies of Indiana’s state educational institutions regarding antisemitism and their response to any acts of antisemitism following the October 7 terrorist attacks against Israel, reiterating Indiana’s support for its Jewish community and condemning antisemitic acts of discrimination and harassment. **What he said** : “A wave of antisemitism across the country began over a year ago with the October 7, 2023 terrorist attack against Israel, with universities often at the epicenter of these incidents. With this executive order, we are making it clear that Indiana will not tolerate antisemitic discrimination at our state institutions or anywhere else — Jewish Hoosiers should know the state of Indiana condemns antisemitism and stands with them.” \- **Governor****Braun** , via a [press release](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/GnEsiRIZaPX-zrzhV2OCOmr84DWBMcf8u0INSwS8nWdTnPwTh_OCOsOo7HIesDtJWWFKWa8yajWpznkpbpLI7wN1K4gmkR7C4qytZHmHb1kUHDwI73ielAP70YdDvZowxdVW-X3x1KO3Wgjo04j6M9hOCgeeUdZF3LZibkEImeqPeU3fW3aRQkoHsl-Hwwya4Lr4pHmmzoqI4Xa8SQvmXzI7G51WypmmEEkjsKGGdeKzx8PG6kDW3dNkUqDhZOOGL_rWtjg-Xr3uAgv1nquVcKBxICa6buTrPpSPiWfxOVgNPpgl_ad78RKGf9_acbrzunDkEJ_AbLkMi8TyvJdBKBvkVpFBtrpx8gTRTBEqGbV1U61dYggCVC98JSdECJrbVdSvikvzXE7oc2DFMQqiwB0VHFBT0T8hd7r8JeCniX-qAOvHO7m4_1FmK7wXdBAdRLtKz2sUmz7we-olVQHL7ggYNosjYxH72t1BeGYDmOO4cP-W_sHyvZwDyEwXEtc87pmmyJZkobktZofebK9H-6M1_3omU27U9YHXh_rXILCeeSXuVRjL2zzR7uxiUd1T-g/PBzoRLybJOgN2DfugBe34GguMUc3pClo/7).

**_Governor Braun Visits White House for Historic Return of Education to the States_**
---
---
**Governor Mike Braun** just yesterday, arrived at the White House to attend the historic signing of President Trump's _Improving Education Outcomes by Empowering Parents, States, and Communities _executive order. This order returns the Department of Education's responsibilities and resources to the states, and close the agency. **What he said** : “Indiana is excited for education to be turned fully back to the states. President Donald Trump [](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/VDAGz2j7nZZgl3B79NAPHa0ytNNisygEESb19mJMyvWiy7t0an8EMAkUMk9FYfHWG8IJL-lmIEtpMM1Hi_pgz2r-eGbyBcnlfmlx886iOoiYSzOQqB-K5arsBIDIOJlJ1Ft0gXr19z2mWl_plRWFTnytGEbGyBIxoCJQmYt7PHPCxoJpmBpfnPABiTnOo1oS1ZGPAcl5qESFV5pW7Lv8pPCkD9iL5OxstP8vh7wDGiK_t5lQZrA3hen_vsNQ9-oYVwJ7xpQr/ZnBAw136qE1vsFETxEozIKzsiewt9m9A/7)understands that Hoosier parents should be in charge of their own kids’ education — not bureaucrats in D.C.” \- **Governor****Braun,** via [X](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/3CIELuPQ2nwHPWGsT5nAXLUbsaCairQWhO319Y8L82asCxKxjLpGC1vvyiPLrvQCNcy9B8IdtG81siA0tVAmyZgEPN_C7wHlURTTeuKubvIQglj77ITJ9RmTQVO53zpkqz0OMff80htMqd2GnD1aP254RIMy0XtE4ZuHFgmkDnmBKwQGj05kdlIFjaoZcnHLsetAEYDg9vJv2z8IjpSP-maBh9dgkpC0smqrNQS0hMFqGM2fvb_vebNWo2oSahXtoGFOhzT-sFajUucHo1duMSnAfgWoQsM26apsbA/qn8pgLQGLHN_5plw_MPGf_AFfT-d9BN-/7).

name: AOC
subject: Common sense
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Here's what I believe:
#
What they like to call ‘radical’, I believe is common sense.
I believe that in the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, when a person gets sick, they shouldn’t go bankrupt.
Common sense.
I believe that a minimum wage should cover the minimum cost to live.
Common sense.
And by the way — we should see that _not_ paying a minimum wage is _corporate welfare_ , because **big companies like Walmart and Amazon rely on the food stamp program and public coffers** to cover the wages that they won't pay.
I believe that homes are not slot machines for investors and Wall Street to extort working families out of every last dollar that they have.
When your landlord jacks up your rent overnight, or housing prices skyrocket because Wall Street treats our housing market like a casino, your government should fight for your ability to keep an affordable roof over your head.
And I believe that **our elected officials should take on abuses of corporate greed everywhere they find it**.
That is why I don’t — and never will — take money from industry lobbyists or corporations. **We deserve better**.
Now, our movement for real progress for everyday people will have to push harder than ever these next four years.
[Help us continue the fight by making a grassroots donation today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250321.HKxy_c&refcode=em20250321-8405-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8405%2E2526796%2EDlqfhT)

President Trump just signed an executive order to DISMANTLE the Department of Education - this failed, bloated bureaucracy has wrecked our schools for decades.

_This is a HUGE win - but we 're not done yet..._

The federal stranglehold is gone - and it's up to the states to take the baton and fix what's broken. **[With your help, we'll win this race and start on DAY ONE in Ohio.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyMV9ZVC0yUC4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTc1NTgtMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjFfWVQtMlAuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE3NTU4LTM2MjMifQ/v3bsyu6eF0rSG3F1q7cc5g "With your help, we’ll win this race and start on DAY ONE in Ohio.")**

And I'm not stopping there:
---
-> School choice is the civil rights issue of our time

Charlie Kirk **[called out an unhinged woke student](https://substack.com/redirect/6190798e-d433-4902-84ca-43cc50482117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who accused "Trump supporters" of calling him the "N" word and threatening to "rape" him.
_**" We are gonna find our real quick if you are telling the truth!!"**_
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/6190798e-d433-4902-84ca-43cc50482117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/6190798e-d433-4902-84ca-43cc50482117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I was hate crimed 5 times in one night," the student told Kirk. "Three of them by Trump supporters."
The student explained further that he was walking when he saw a truck with "4 white men" inside, "MAGA apparel, everything, you know."
"Did they say 'this is MAGA country?'" Kirk joked with a look of disbelief on his face, referencing the false allegations made by actor Jussie Smollett that he was attacked by racist Trump supporters in the middle of Chicago.
The student continued," They drove past me and said 'f**K you n***er!'"

body:

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sthqix&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dj9kqttugnk5cd85kde6u25cbyzbcvytzwqpqygkm0dhrotu2wh8uqzuwnqup1cqrcmt38ykxu5iqrqry4j57191aipwk12vhy4qbfx5t9u67fa935mzxnkhyjuqpa50ccmvk3mlo56vzab07x9g&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sthqix&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sthqix&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sthqix&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sthqix&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dj9kqttugnk5cd85kde6u25cl9c5knwortxf3f8xsppc9z7reeuqak40cgu7fz5snzof3e2fa607cv4mrm10fzuepf6vglpveol9wnxdfbvaudps52qm8nx5ngengtax2llicvjl76i95pen59bg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sthqix&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sthqix&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Martin has been using his office to do two things, profess his love of Donald Trump and intimidate Trump’s opponents into silence. So far, he has sent letters threatening legal action to Senate Minority Leader Schumer, Rep. Eugene Vindman, and me.
[Can you chip in today to make sure I have the legal resources to stand strong against whatever the Department of Justice throws at me?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104284597/534862660/83388251?refcode2=ff8419a5-9606-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&refcode=em250321&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZjg0MTlhNS05NjA2LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qpsxkoOyBUSC6OVIVNHnD4_rKxEHWXRNkdej7qtFPV4=)

[Between the DOJ and Musk’s deep pockets, we’ve got a huge battle ahead in this next election. body:
Republican leaders are now advising their lawmakers to avoid town halls—dodging the very people they claim to represent. They don’t want to face the tough questions.

| Hello Friend, **have you seen the latest?**

_**Republican leaders are now advising their lawmakers to _avoid_ town halls**_— _dodging_ the very people they claim to represent. They don’t want to face the tough questions. They don’t want to be held accountable. And they certainly don’t want to explain why they keep putting their own interests ahead of yours. **This is not leadership. This is cowardice.

_And it is up to us to stop it._**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104285160/534864619/454209827?refcode=BLU_EM_SAN_2025-03-21_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNzI0OTA4Yi05NzA2LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KW-Ap_g2yWh3FpjbyhtezR8blhoM9xWXyNBOVhEMzQQ=)
**I believe in something different.** Over the past few weeks, I’ve been showing up— _everywhere_. At the 3rd Annual Community Prayer Breakfast, talking with local leaders. At Tranquil Villas, hearing from our seniors over coffee. At the Walton County NAACP Freedom Fund Dinner, celebrating progress and discussing the work ahead. At protests, meeting families who just want a better future for their kids.

I’m here because _**this is my job**_ —to listen, to show up, and to fight for you.

**With just days until the special election, we have to make a choice:** Do we want more representatives who hide from the people they serve? Or do we elect leaders who will stand in front of their communities and _answer to them_?

name: Pete Maysmith, Incoming LCV President
subject: A message from Pete Maysmith
body:
Meet LCV’s new president

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIyNzgxNDAS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE4MDMyNTMwMQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
|
* * *
---
| | | | Dear Peter,
---
| | I attended my first protest when I was in elementary school. Although I didn’t know it at the time, my experience linking arms alongside my mom, my younger sister, and countless others protesting a nuclear weapons facility would shape the rest of my life. That morning, I learned my first lesson about the **power of collective action.**
---
| | Since then, I’ve spent more than 30 years in the environmental movement, including 16 years with the Conservation Voters Movement as my professional home, the last eight of which I’ve served as LCV’s Senior Vice President of Campaigns. **Now, as LCV’s incoming president, I’m enormously excited to be stepping into a role that allows me to grow the environmental movement’s power even more.**
---
| | [ ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT-~LZKs_)
---
| | LCV and the Conservation Voters Movement build political power for people and the planet with the aim of stopping climate change and strengthening our nation’s democracy. We do this by organizing, advocating, holding leaders accountable, and electing pro-climate, pro-democracy leaders to office.
---
| | Our organization is smart and strategic, and, **most importantly, we have the support of people like you.** Your generosity and commitment allows us to create long-lasting climate policies, and to reach people directly so that they can make the connection between the impacts of climate and democracy polices and their daily lives.
---
| | Though these are dark and deeply disturbing times — our hard-won climate progress is in jeopardy, our ability to tackle racial inequality is at substantial risk, and our nation’s democratic institutions are under assault — **I’m confident that, together, our movement can build a more just and more prosperous society.**
---
| | As LCV’s next president, I look forward to working alongside you, our fantastic staff, and our state affiliates all across the country to ensure a safer, healthier future for all.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
| | Pete Maysmith
_Incoming LCV President_
---
| |
---
| | |
* * *
---
| | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you,[ _update your contact information_](https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=12278140&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjE4MDMyNTMwMQS2&spReportId=MjE4MDMyNTMwMQS2) _._ [_Click here to unsubscribe_](https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/Unsubscribe?spMailingID=12278140&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjE4MDMyNTMwMQS2&spReportId=MjE4MDMyNTMwMQS2) from our supporter list. [_Send us any comments, criticisms, or feedback here_](mailto:feedback@lcv.org?subject=) , or just reply to this email! Thanks for your support.
**740 15th St NW, Suite 700**
**Washington, DC 20005**
**202-785-8683**
---

📢 Filing Taxes Should Be Free — And Now It Finally Is
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250321-1&t=1&akid=1882%2E587540%2ESzwnp8)
Peter,
When we file our taxes, most of us are getting taxed twice —
💰 By the government
💰 By greedy corporations making billions off tax season
Let’s talk about how you can finally stop paying $300 for TurboTax.
**Introducing #DirectFile**
For the first time in 2025, there’s a way to file your taxes — and it’s actually _free_.
It’s called #DirectFile, a new tax filing system from the IRS that lets you file directly with the government — no middlemen, no hidden fees.
[ ](http://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/1626?t=2&akid=1882%2E587540%2ESzwnp8)
It has many of the same features as TurboTax:
✅ Easy to use
✅ Step-by-step guidance
✅ No hidden fees
But there’s one big difference: It cuts out the corporations that have been profiting off of you.
**Why Haven't You Heard About This?**
Because TurboTax and H&R Block do **NOT** want you to know about it.
These companies have spent millions lobbying against #DirectFile — because if Americans get free tax filing, they lose billions in profits.
[ ](http://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/1626?t=3&akid=1882%2E587540%2ESzwnp8)
Despite that lobbying, the Biden Administration kept it in place — and even the Trump Administration left it for 2025.
That means if you qualify, you can use it this year.
**Who Can Use It?**
Not everyone is eligible (yet), but millions of Americans are.
🔎 Check your eligibility here: [**directfile.irs.gov**](http://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/1626?t=4&akid=1882%2E587540%2ESzwnp8)
If you qualify, you should absolutely try it out.
**Filing your taxes should be free — not a way for corporations to profit off you.**
In solidarity,
Leaders We Deserve

Today our campaign shared some very positive news. Now we are about to face the implications of sharing that news
| | | | Josh Weil is the Democratic Nominee to flip Florida's 6th congressional district. Thank you for your crucial support for Josh and for stopping the chaos and harm over the next four years. However if you'd like to unsubscribe, you can do so at the link at the bottom of this email.

| | | | Team,
Today, with 11 days until our election, we found out we outraised our Republican opponent by a margin of 10 to 1.
This coupled with the fact that voter turnout between Democrats and Republicans is nearly even in early voting, and that we trail Republicans by 17 votes in a key county, has meant a lot of media coverage:
---
| | | | | [](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001c7ePYdFXawDsdOfLQ2lnit-aT8z3YsDX8cHNy-vthJq8-_jjmFlL3DT6HRu-eie2-VXn4OICkG5MpHoMkZvCLmGJp6VqEnePzr_F-vh32Y56tangaegcYwDoOIB4LfLASv-TTtpBDXCtu7cxkCz8ov6MP6JCdRHxe3WdC0XMDOh-iac4odNXGtccMWzDiqDEdig8l3gY40cLhtn1oMif4W4f2ktJPMAk&c=cchS7TUcL1fAM2jTVXJnwbSbGsQqSpGA0UHJdPG1Yiw4-a1FIji5UA==&ch=WmO2lNFSuhd_pU0OpTYIkHTf_FH4qr_HCPN8f5MG_4RTLwGLuni-SQ==)
---
| | | | You'd think that this would equate to a massive fundraising day for our campaign. Incorrect.
It is a psychological phenomenon that plagues every campaign that sees big shocking wins.
Supporters see the positive feedback of national press coverage, strong fundraising numbers, and impressive early voting trends, and come to the conclusion that the race is in the bag and that the campaign doesn't need help.
Look at how our fundraising dropped off after all the positive stories today:
---
| | | | | [](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001c7ePYdFXawDsdOfLQ2lnit-aT8z3YsDX8cHNy-vthJq8-_jjmFlL3DT6HRu-eie2-VXn4OICkG5MpHoMkZvCLmGJp6VqEnePzr_F-vh32Y56tangaegcYwDoOIB4LfLASv-TTtpBDXCtu7cxkCz8ov6MP6JCdRHxe3WdC0XMDOh-iac4odNXGtccMWzDiqDEdig8l3gY40fkV5WHHXIGbjBWhHqDfONf&c=cchS7TUcL1fAM2jTVXJnwbSbGsQqSpGA0UHJdPG1Yiw4-a1FIji5UA==&ch=WmO2lNFSuhd_pU0OpTYIkHTf_FH4qr_HCPN8f5MG_4RTLwGLuni-SQ==)
---
| | | | It might not look like a massive drop but we are 100k off target from reaching our minimum daily budget goals heading into early-voting.
Not meeting our budget means not competing with our opponent on the airwaves while tv's across our district are saturated with attack ads against us.
We do NOT have this race in the bag. MAGA has 11 days to catch up.
[If we get complacent we lose this race. We work every day to build a more affordable, equitable, and prosperous region, but we know we need partners in every neighborhood willing to build with us. Hard decisions need to be made to help our region rebound and they need to be made together. We created NeighborsPAC to educate, engage, and mobilize residents about the work Metro's doing and the measures it refers to voters. We're fighting to:
* Create more affordable housing and reduce homelessness,
* Improve our roads and public transit,
* Protect clean air and water,
* Ensure that growth serves livable, thriving communities across the Portland metropolitan area,
* Prioritize and uplift vulnerable communities.

**We believe that by working together as neighbors, we can create a stronger, more connected, and more resilient region. Nikki recently introduced a game-changing piece of legislation — the bipartisan _Protect Postal Performance Act_ — that stands up for all of us. 📬 **Here's the scoop:** This bill aims to protect our United States Postal Service (USPS) from downsizing in the areas that need it the most, where it could hurt local communities the hardest. Plus, it pushes for more eyes on changes to delivery schedules and more openness about any potential tweaks. We’ve all felt it — noticeable delays in delivery services. Whether it's paychecks arriving late, bills becoming overdue, or important medications not reaching us on time, this is an issue that hits at the core of our daily lives. Nikki hears these concerns loud and clear and is taking action to prevent any further disruption to our mail services. 🚨 Nikki has also been closely tracking any moves to privatize the Postal Service and she isn’t staying quiet. This change would hit rural communities the hardest and threaten local jobs. She is going to keep fighting to oppose such a disastrous move. It’s up to us now. Plus, it pushes for more eyes on changes to delivery schedules and more openness about any potential tweaks. We’ve all felt it — noticeable delays in delivery services. Whether it's paychecks arriving late, bills becoming overdue, or important medications not reaching us on time, this is an issue that hits at the core of our daily lives. Nikki hears these concerns loud and clear and is taking action to prevent any further disruption to our mail services. 🚨 Nikki has also been closely tracking any moves to privatize the Postal Service and she isn’t staying quiet. This change would hit rural communities the hardest and threaten local jobs. She is going to keep fighting to oppose such a disastrous move. It’s up to us now. We’re calling on you to stand with Congresswoman Budzinski and show your support for the bipartisan Protect Postal Performance Act. 🖊️ | By supporting this critical legislation, we can prevent mail delays from getting worse and hold the Postmaster General accountable for protecting the USPS and reliable service for our communities. So I figured we take a little walk down memory lane. Did Democrats always want open borders? Did they always enjoy abusing taxpayer dollars? Did they always think cutting waste, fraud and abuse was bad? Well, thanks to the internet we can see that Democrats are just hypocrites, they ran on promises like deportation and cutting waste, they are only up in arms now because President Trump is actually delivering on those promises. Matt Cole is the CEO of Strive Asset Management, Strive was founded by Vivek Ramaswamy to provide an "anti-woke" approach to investing. Matt walks us through the push by giants like Blackrock and Vanguard as they integrated ESG and DEI policies in financial institutes and corporate America. Thankfully, guys like Robby Starbuck and President Trump are ripping DEI out by the root and Strive is leading the way on the investing front. Matt unpacks cryptocurrency for us, what to invest in and what to stay away from. Matt feels Bitcoin will be the digital reserve currency of the future, so if you haven't yet, invest in Bitcoin!

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=e44962962d1841ca86a99d6290a3c029&_e=Ww3kzfqiXN-WbzqWE_0Rt6EOdvqwddWHQmDsOHucEs5XHIkR4uI91-GKKHEqatr22aS25hzbS37edMu5vzFirjiggrKqqPki7Xmrv6n5WSU2ud37flKODK81qxqAhExf4HseVJ1M2faRJh6TcGcNaFUMKoHXAJh2jwR83zv1PxcZnbD2y4mnG1z-hmvxOsT-evd0bTIfFx_t0WEye51OEm_pmrOsTFmO98ep7nlnlx6iGPl5OVOC9T13_K5fh0MVb1z_FflNy9w2iR6AajmEBXGWabRuSdgmAGsa4uD6Wnm_6eNbhYd4afwI3_4-RhAi8aJBlJ9j7I-wHYiEez7SRFlt9dIVzIkW3-WHNSaCfmu0dyeQEw3m_FEpN0_5Cherh097zYJ6YdWE0iLN29ZB5voX3XFVv9XDNIOt-9U146U%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=e44962962d1841ca86a99d6290a3c029&_e=Ww3kzfqiXN-WbzqWE_0Rt6EOdvqwddWHQmDsOHucEs5XHIkR4uI91-GKKHEqatr22aS25hzbS37edMu5vzFirjiggrKqqPki7Xmrv6n5WSU2ud37flKODK81qxqAhExf4HseVJ1M2faRJh6TcGcNaFUMKoHXAJh2jwR83zv1PxcZnbD2y4mnG1z-hmvxOsT-evd0bTIfFx_t0WEye51OEm_pmrOsTFmO98ep7nlnlx6iGPl5OVOC9T13_K5fh0MVb1z_FflNy9w2iR6AajmEBR4g4F7HyZwcTrjXEimQDitXg5oHRTUtUxWbzkNyXNz_LrEsozNM8vAucQnWSEpyJdCFFTpF1AkHLi-8Ep8CSBrsmyWjYfCunSPwpI-p9Msa3JCtYc3lX0ZwR0sPrxwTAHJo9saf6VqjfhJkO7RB6mQ%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt, R-Ala. has come out in support of President Donald Trump’s executive order on Thursday that effectively dismantles the country’s Department of Education, saying she prefers to keep these choices closer to home.

“Educational decisions should be made at the most local level possible- starting with parents,” she said in a post to X Thursday.

“[Trump] and Linda McMahon are putting students and families first. This is the way.”

The U.S. Senate has passed the Halt All Lethal Trafficking (HALT) of Fentanyl Act, a bill aimed at addressing the nation’s ongoing fentanyl crisis. Senator Katie Britt (R-Ala.) expressed her strong support for the legislation, emphasizing its role in combating the influx of fentanyl into the United States.

“We made a promise to the American people to take decisive action against the deadly fentanyl crisis, and with the passage of the HALT Fentanyl Act, we are keeping that promise,” Britt stated. “This legislation makes it clear that the era of allowing fentanyl to flow into our country is over.”

I’m focused on the real issues Oregonians are facing and tackling them head on. |
#
---
Peter — I am working to build a future of opportunity and justice for all Oregonians. And I will always fight for the Oregon that I know is possible: Where no one has to live in a tent on a sidewalk. Where people seeking help for a mental health concern or substance use issue can find and afford the support they need. Where every child receives a high-quality public education. Where everyone has financial stability and pathways to greater opportunity. Where no one has to choose between paying rent or paying for life-saving prescription drugs. Where people have the reproductive rights that older generations have had. With the chaos coming from the federal government, our work in Oregon has never been more important. I’m not distracted by the headlines and headaches from the Trump administration –I’m focused on the real issues Oregonians are facing and tackling them head on. **[With your support, we can keep up these important fights and create an Oregon where everyone, in each of our 36 counties, can thrive. body:
Healthcare is a human right—not a commodity. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWvD99O_7A35PfMlVW_9V2tBv3PWtD_4Ufc3xipbuheIcMQ-Oc6UNrSoXAHeY9mpDbk51lZLNklWlPPI3uo9CwTz2J4j315nLY5NefWhN1d6bbLMhlyVAhY63vFDzpqOJrcnLueWovAzqm32ZmGjcMHg/4ez/jExZw2lSS_CX03BLX_bnag/h0/h001.sNEMKVe8cpJOJr_NXNqJqk62qYwL93jOtVXKW6FN4LE)
---
Friend, Congressional Republicans are attempting to make massive cuts to programs that millions of lower-income and disabled Americans depend on every day—including $880 billion in cuts to Medicaid and threats to the _Affordable Care Act_. **As budget negotiations continue in the House and Senate, right now is the time to keep pushing back against planned cuts to healthcare.** Some Republicans in Congress and the Trump administration have signaled that they may be susceptible to pressure from the public in support of Medicaid. 2.6 million Michiganders benefit from Medicaid coverage. | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104290732/534880679/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU3ZGZmYTM0LWE4MDYtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dK73i9lNfS7QCGJbUxhLi7m_tAoP1H88T4VyCsp_L04=&emci=87e3b700-8206-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=57dffa34-a806-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=8431045)

Peter — Today, North Carolina’s Court of Appeals considered a case that could **overturn a free and fair election. ** Multiple recounts have confirmed that Republican Jefferson Griffin lost last November’s state supreme court election to Democratic incumbent Justice Allison Riggs. Yet rather than concede, Jefferson Griffin and state Republicans are still suing to try to steal this seat on North Carolina’s highest court — **a dangerous, anti-democratic power grab that could have long-lasting consequences.** Attorney General Eric Holder put it best: | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104290733/534880688/-1782990313?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_NCMonthly_email_20250321-NDRC-Tier1-NCMonthly_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250321-NDRC-Tier1-NCMonthly_&utm_campaign=NCMonthly&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU3ZGZmYTM0LWE4MDYtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dK73i9lNfS7QCGJbUxhLi7m_tAoP1H88T4VyCsp_L04=)
---
As a proud North Carolinian, it pains me to witness what’s happening in my state right now. This is just the latest in a long line of attacks on fair elections here.
**But truth be told, these anti-democratic attacks are not confined to the Tar Heel state — and if Republicans succeed here, you can guarantee they’ll try them in other states across the country.**
The NDRC is working around the clock to defend free and fair elections. And we’ll keep fighting to elect candidates (including state supreme court justices) who uphold the will of the people — and respect the freedom to vote.
**We’ve seen how far GOP extremists are willing to go — and because these fights don't stop on Election Days (voting ended in this race over four months ago!), we need to make sure we’re always ready to fight back. **
A monthly gift is the best way to help our grassroots movement respond to the latest attacks _and_ keep our longer-term work to protect democracy going strong.
[**Please make a monthly investment that will provide a steady stream of resources to power our democracy-saving work.
